Description: Aldena Therapeutics develops innovative therapies for Dermatology: changing the paradigm by discovering and enabling delivery of nucleic acid therapies in conditions with high burden to patients

Name: Travera
Description:
Travera uses a breakthrough measurement tool invented at MIT to directly measure which cancer drugs are most likely to be effective for each individual cancer patient prior to them taking the drugs.  The company offers CLIA certified Rapid Therapy Guidance Tests for all major cancers and 100+ FDA-approved cancer drugs, with a turnaround time of only two days. 
*See if you qualify for FREE testing through Early Access:  https://form.jotform.com/241784594580165

Name: Helicos Biosciences Corporation
Description:
The Helicos Genetic Analysis System is the first technology capable of true direct RNA, cDNA and DNA measurements available to the scientific community.  The system is comprised of the HeliScopeTM Single Molecule Sequencer, the HeliScopeTM Analysis Engine, and the HeliScopeTM Sample Loader.  Novel reagent packaging and intuitive software provide for easy operation, automated tracking of consumables, and overall management of the system.

Helicos has recently launched a sequencing services program that allows scientists to access the revolutionary Helicos single molecule DNA, cDNA and direct RNA sequencing technologies. Helicos True Single Molecule Sequencing (tSMSTM) and Direct RNA Sequencing (DRSTM) technologies provides a direct measurement of billions of individual RNA/DNA molecules with high accuracy, simplicity, and scale. Our technologies require no amplification, ligation, cDNA synthesis (for Direct RNA Sequencing) or other complex sample manipulation, and eliminate the biases associated with amplification-based sequencing techniques. Our mission is to eliminate bottlenecks and to improve productivity, as well as to continue the discovery of new and novel research and development findings in an affordable manner.

Name: Nest.Bio
Description: Nest.Bio is a venture creation and venture capital firm focused on leveraging technological breakthroughs to develop, fund, and commercialize next-generation biotechnology globally. We build and enable breakthrough biotechnology to improve human health and the social environment.

Name: Acurx Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: ACXP)
Description: Acurx Pharmaceuticals is a publicly held, clinical stage biopharmaceutical company developing a new class of antibiotics for infections caused by bacteria listed as priority pathogens by the World Health Organization, Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, and Food and Drug Administration.
Location: Staten Island, New York, United States

Name: Mary Tyler Moore Vision Initiative
Description:
- Our Vision is a world without vision loss from diabetes. 

 
- Our Mission is to preserve and restore vision in people with diabetes. 

- Our Purpose is to ensure people with diabetes can live joyful and independent lives free from the fear and suffering of vision loss. 



MARY TYLER MOORE is a TV Icon and a role model who broke down barriers and opened doors for women around the world!  Loved and respected, not just for her accomplishments as an award-winning actress and producer, but because Mary embodied kindness, grace, and compassion. Mary was diagnosed with type 1 diabetes as a young woman and suffered from diabetes-related vision loss and other complications during her life.  For decades Mary played an international leading role in raising  awareness of the devastating impacts of diabetes and billions of dollars to support diabetes research. Her dream was to help find a cures for diabetes and its complications, including vision loss and put an end once and for all to the suffering of millions of people around the world afflicted with this disease.
 
In a first of its kind global collaboration, The Mary Tyler Moore Vision Initiative (MTM Vision) has brought together leaders and innovators from academia, pharma, bio-tech, government, and the non-profit sectors to work together to accelerate the development of new methods to preserve and restore vision for those at risk for and suffering from diabetic retinal disease (DRD). DRD is the leading cause of blindness in working-age adults worldwide and sadly, new research has shown that even children with diabetes and normal routine eye exams can already have underlying abnormalities of visual function. By establishing and sharing essential scientific resources for the  study of human disease, encouraging collaboration and data sharing on a dedicated platform, and supporting goal-driven, science-with-a-mission programs, MTM Vision will lead the movement to create a world without vision loss from diabetes.
Location: New York, New York, United States

Name: Argento Scientific
Description:
Argento Scientific simplifies downstream process development by providing reliable, cost-effective chromatography solutions for biopharmaceutical researchers at some of the biggest biopharmaceutical companies in the world.  We focus on bench scale column hardware, column packing, solvent waste safety solutions, and accessories.
 
We help researchers with their downstream process development by freeing up their time - allowing them to get back to the real science!

Name: Phlotonics Inc.
Description:
Phlotonics is developing the molecular monitoring infrastructure needed to scale biological manufacturing.

Today, manufacturers rely primarily on indirect process signals or offline assays to understand what cells are doing during culture. These approaches provide useful information but offer limited visibility into the molecular signals that drive cellular behavior.

Phlotonics is building photonic biosensor platforms that enable real-time monitoring of secreted proteins and signaling molecules directly within biological processes.

This capability allows manufacturers to detect process drift earlier, better understand cellular state, and improve control of complex biological production systems.

Initial deployments are focused on cell therapy manufacturing, where process variability and batch value are both extremely high. Phlotonics collaborates with organizations including the Advanced Regenerative Manufacturing Institute, AIM Photonics, and BioMADE.

The company also participates in research programs supported by the Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority integrating biosensors with microphysiological systems at the University of Rochester Medical Center.

Phlotonics’ long-term vision is to provide the biological data infrastructure required for the next generation of:

• cell therapy manufacturing
• biologics production
• AI-enabled bioprocess control

Name: Sailgene Technology
Description:
Sailgene Technology (USA) is a company specializing in nanopore sequencing, next-generation sequencing and the development and application of bioinformatics analysis technology. The core team has years of experience in high-throughput sequencing, Nanopore sequencing and bioinformatics analysis.
Sailgene is equpied with Nanopore PromethION, PacBio, illumina and DNBSEQ sequencing platforms and a variety of self-developed extraction,library construction and sequencingreagent kits. In the field of DNA sequencing, we have implemented large and complex genome sequencing based on Nanopore platform, and Ultra-long Sequencing has broken through N50>200K, In the field of RNA sequencing, we have developed several RNA sequencing products based on the Nanopore platform, including Direct RNA Sequencing, Direct-CDNA, LncRNA and Single-cell Full-length Transcriptome. In the field of microbiology sequencing, we independently developed a microbial detection system based on Nanopore platform,covering all the published microbial genomes. We continue to maintain the innovation and development ofsequencing technology, and are committed to providing every customer with the most perfect service!

Name: ProVerde Laboratories
Description: ProVerde Laboratories is building a full service analytical testing laboratory specializing in separation sciences.  State-of-the-art Liquid Chromatography (LC), Gas Chromatography (GC), Supercritical Fluid Chromatography (SFC) and Convergence Chromatography (CC) techniques will be used to provide services to include chromatographic method development, batch release testing, basic research and consultation services.  Chromatographic techniques will be coupled with Mass Spectrometric (MS) detection to achieve the highest possible sensitivity for applications in pharma, materials science, petroleum, and clinical research.

Name: Applied BioPhysics, Inc.
Description: Applied BioPhysics manufactures ECIS (Electric Cell-Substrate Impedance Sensing) - a whole cell biosensor that uses weak electric current to measure cell behavior.

Name: Deco Labs
Description: Developing animal-origin-free (AOF) culture media ingredients for animal cell cultivation. Our first & flagship product, cAlbumin, fully replaces the role of BSA (bovine serum albumin) in cell culture.

Name: Xenetic Biosciences, Inc.
Description:
Xenetic Biosciences, Inc. (NASDAQ: XBIO) is a biopharmaceutical company focused on progressing XCART, a personalized CAR T platform technology engineered to target patient-specific tumor neoantigens. The Company is initially advancing cell-based therapeutics targeting the unique B-cell receptor on the surface of an individual patient’s malignant tumor cells for the treatment of B-cell lymphomas. XCART has the potential to fuel a robust pipeline of therapeutic assets targeting high-value oncology indications.

Additionally, Xenetic is leveraging PolyXenTM, its proprietary drug delivery platform, by partnering with biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies. PolyXenTM has demonstrated its ability to improve the half-life and other pharmacological properties of next-generation biologic drugs. The Company has an exclusive license agreement with Takeda Pharmaceuticals Co. Ltd. in the field of coagulation disorders and expects to earn royalty payments under this agreement.

Name: Convergence Forum
Description:
What opportunities get created as fields converge? What challenges surface as markets, policies, and investing dynamics shift? What new scientific discoveries are potential game-changers? Convergence exists to explore those questions (and many others), with a high-level audience interested in what's happening in the rapidly-converging worlds of biotech, pharma, healthcare, medical devices, and the Internet.

The Convergence Forum fosters real debate and discussion among audiences that are every bit as high-level as the speakers.  The programs provide an opportunity for participants to make important new contacts, do business, explore important new directions in research, delve deeply into what it takes to maintain competitive advantage in a fast-changing world, and leave feeling recharged.

Name: Barnwell Bio
Description:
Barnwell Bio turns your barn's microbiome into actionable intelligence. We help poultry operations detect emerging health threats before clinical signs appear — giving producers the lead time to intervene early, reduce losses, and make more precise intervention decisions.

Our proprietary platform analyzes environmental samples via metagenomic sequencing to provide continuous, non-invasive surveillance of barn-level pathogen dynamics. Beyond early detection, we help producers and their veterinarians evaluate treatment efficacy, by tracking microbial shifts in response to interventions and informing what actions to take next.

We support hard-working producers in navigating the many challenges of modern agriculture, saving them time and money, and giving them confidence in the critical animal health and management decisions they are making every day. 

We work with customers across the country, and are supported by veterinary and agriculture experts from leading universities and non-profit organizations. 

If you’re interested in learning more, reach out to hello@barnwellbio.com.
Location: New York, New York, United States

Name: Kerafast, part of Absolute Biotech
Description:
At Kerafast, our mission is to make unique laboratory-made research tools easily accessible to the global scientific community. Our portfolio includes cell lines, antibodies, small molecules, dyes and more, many of which are not available elsewhere. Since our founding in 2011, researchers from more than 170 institutions worldwide have made their innovative reagents available through our online platform, where the materials can be quickly accessed without needing to go through the traditional Material Transfer Agreement process.

We handle all selling and shipping logistics for the providing laboratory, as well as return generous royalty payments from every sale. We therefore help providing labs save time and resources, while generating extra funding for further research. Procuring scientists can more easily discover and access unique reagents that are often unavailable elsewhere, while also funding the work of other researchers. This creates a global community of scientists contributing and accessing Reagents for the Greater Good to accelerate their own research as well as scientific progress overall.

In 2018, Kerafast merged with Absolute Antibody, a UK-based company with a vision to make recombinant antibody technology available to all researchers. In 2022, we became part of Absolute Biotech, a new company that unites multiple life science brands into one organization specializing in antibody reagents and services. Learn more at absolutebiotech.com.

Name: VALID Inc
Description: The traditional drug development pipeline is marred by high failure rates and inefficiencies, largely due to unreliable and non-translating research models. VALID focuses on addressing this critical issue using advanced/complex hiPSC-derived models with increased predictive validity. Transforming Drug Development with VALID Techbio 2.0: Predictive Validity/Efficacy at Scale Better Data = Better Targets = Successful Drug Discovery.

Name: Technology Ventures Office, Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center
Description: The mission of the Technology Ventures Office (TVO) is to help translate BIDMC research and innovation for society's benefit. By working closely with our investigators and researchers in the labs and clinics, we manage BIDMC intellectual property, negotiate pre-clinical research and license agreements and catalyze alliances with industry.

Name: Vytala
Description:
Vytala is a US-based food technology company, where heart, hope, and science meet to transform lives. Founded with a deep sense of purpose, we’re committed to changing how people use food as medicine. By advancing nutrition, it’s our aim to end nutrient deficiencies, starting with fat malabsorption. 
Gastrointestinal (GI) disease impacts 1 in 5 Americans, with 2 out of 3 experiencing GI symptoms, burdening the healthcare system with billions in costs. Fat malabsorption, a major contributor to digestive issues, can lead to severe developmental problems in children and chronic malnutrition in adults.
Our proprietary lipid technology is clinically proven to enhance fat and nutrient absorption, optimizing weight gain, height growth, and overall health. Our first product is classified as a medical food and is eligible for CMS reimbursement. Join us on our mission to help people achieve their best health through the power of nutrition.
Visit VytalaHealth.com to learn more.

Name: ARMR Sciences Inc.

Name: Nucleate Pittsburgh
Description:
Welcome to Nucleate Pittsburgh, a chapter of Nucleate, the world's largest student-led organization representing bio-innovators.

Nucleate is a free, trainee-led 501(c)(3) non-profit organization dedicated to  empowering the next generation of biotech leaders. As a global organization, we democratize biotech education, spark new intellectual communities, and build bridges within and across ecosystems by providing open-access programming, events and resources.

Name: XCMR
Description:
XCMR is a pioneering techbio company specializing in breakthrough biosecurity innovations in non-pharmaceutical medical countermeasures for biodefense. 

Together with its academic, industry and government partners, we integrate proprietary UV-C technology into wearable, portable, and stationary devices for personal protection and to prevent the transmission of infectious diseases. 

Our IoT cloud platform leverages AI-driven predictive analytics to enhance visibility, response, and preparedness for scalable infection transmission resiliency.

Name: Womb WatchAI
Description:
Womb WatchAI is the AI Operating System for Women's Health — clinical intelligence infrastructure that ends the fragmentation that has defined women's care for generations.

Today, the patient is the integration layer. She holds the pieces her OB/GYN, endocrinologist, cardiologist, and primary care doctor never share with each other. We built the technology that ends that.

Our flagship platform, Rhythm by Womb WatchAI, is an AI-powered health app and Digital Twin platform that unifies every health variable a woman generates — cycle, flow, symptoms, nutrition, wearable data, and lab results — into one continuous picture of how her body actually works. Integrated with Apple Health and Google Health. Every user generates a physician-ready health summary her doctor can act on.

Whether she is navigating endometriosis, PCOS, fibroids, adenomyosis, perimenopause, pregnancy, or unexplained symptoms, Rhythm helps her decode her biology and move from living longer in poor health into true healthspan optimization — because living longer only matters if she feels good doing it.

Rhythm is powered by our proprietary Bio-Intent Orchestration SystemTM (BIOSTM), the foundational intelligence layer that supports our approach to Bio-VigilanceTM — decoding female biology with greater fidelity, continuity, and foresight than legacy systems ever could.

Your Body. Your Science. Your Rhythm.
Location: New York, New York, United States

Name: XenoTherapeutics
Description:
XenoTherapeutics is on a mission to move regenerative medicine beyond its reliance on deceased human donors. For decades, tissue banks have saved lives by recovering and processing cadaver tissue. That work remains essential. But it is limited by supply, variability, and the reality that access depends on tragedy.

We believe we can do better.

XenoTherapeutics is building the first xenotransplant tissue bank, changing the donor source for regenerative medicine from deceased humans to purpose-bred, genetically engineered animals. Our goal is to create a reliable, scalable, and clinically ready supply of lifesaving tissues that does not depend on human loss.

Our first product is realSKIN, a viable porcine skin xenotransplant derived from genetically engineered, alpha-Gal free pigs. realSKIN is designed to function as living dermal tissue for severe burns. It provides immediate, biologically active wound coverage that integrates and persists, supporting partial wound healing and facilitating surgical wound closure where donor tissue is scarce.

Skin is our starting point because the need is urgent and the path is defined. Our broader vision is a platform approach. Once xenotransplant supply is established for one tissue, it unlocks the potential to provide multiple tissue types through a continuous and predictable system of care.

At XenoTherapeutics, we combine biologics development, dual-path regulatory strategy across CBER and CVM, scalable supply chain infrastructure through an integrated xenotransplant tissue bank, and clinical trial execution under Orphan and RMAT pathways.

We partner with burn centers, trauma networks, public health agencies, and mission-aligned investors to bring this work to patients now.

We believe the future of regenerative medicine is defined by readiness, not tragedy.

Name: UNIKUM Therapeutics
Description:
Unikum Therapeutics is an early stage biotech company currently located in Aarhus, Denmark and Boston, USA. It was spun out from the Department of Biomedicine at Aarhus University in 2020, supported by BioInnovation Institute and Danish Innovation Foundation. In 2022, the company raised a Seed investment with US-based VC Volnay Therapeutics. 

 
It’s founded on the breakthrough discovery on how to manufacture a specific type of innate immune cells, namely plasmacytoid Dendritic Cells (pDCs) for use in cellular therapies, including cancer immunotherapy.
pDCs are multifaceted immune cells with features that have been lacking in existing therapies.

UNIKUM Therapeutics has developed methods to genetically engineer the cells, thereby further enhancing their therapeutic potential and establishing a unique position to champion a whole new class of cellular therapies.

Name: Abound Bio
Description:
Abound Bio is a company whose mission is to generate novel antibody-based biological therapeutics to meet unmet medical needs in the fields of cancer and infectious disease. Abound Bio is led by world renowned experts in the therapeutic antibody, infectious disease, and cancer space with a significant track record of successful development of biotherapeutics, licensing, and partnerships.

In 2022, Abound Bio was acquired by Galapagos, a fully integrated biotechnology company. Since then, they have been united around a single purpose: to transform patient outcomes through life-changing science and innovation for more years of life and quality of life. As a result, we will be sharing all company updates, news, and insights on the Galapagos’ page as of now. 

Please follow Galapagos to stay updated on our latest developments and join our vibrant community. This page will stay online for cv referencing and historic purposes but will not be used to communicate updates. Name: Kirkstall Ltd

Name: Brain Modulation Lab
Description: We are a human systems neuroscience lab studying brain electrophysiology and behavior in patients undergoing surgery for epilepsy, movement disorders, and psychiatric disease. The goal of our work is to facilitate the development and optimization of electrical and biological brain modulation therapies, by filling critical gaps in our understanding of human brain function.

Name: OCEAN BIOMEDICAL
Description:
Ocean Biomedical is a new-generation biopharma company that partners with leading scientists and research institutions to accelerate the translation of new discoveries into breakthrough medicines.

We're working to bring together the interdisciplinary expertise and resources required to develop a diverse portfolio of pharmaceutical inventions and technologies through preclinical, clinical, and commercial development. We aim to build a continuous pipeline of drug development opportunities through our relationships with universities and medical centers.
Our current product candidates consist of preclinical programs each with potential for broad application in oncology, fibrosis, and the treatment and prevention of severe malaria.

Our programs in oncology and fibrosis are based on discoveries of disease pathways and related drug targets emerging from pioneering work in the field of chitinase biology by our scientific co-founder, Jack A. Elias, M.D., a pulmonary specialist who was formerly the Dean of Medicine at Brown, and the Chairman of Medicine at Yale.

In infectious disease, we are developing both therapeutic and vaccine candidates against malaria, a disease that kills 500,000 children and infects 200-300 million people globally each year. Our malaria program is built on the discovery by Jonathan Kurtis, M.D., of two novel malaria antigens, PfSEA-1 and PfGARP which have shown a significant reduction in malaria parasites under multiple levels of in-vitro and animal model testing. (press links below). Kurtis is the Chairman of Pathology and Laboratory Medicine at Brown and the founding director of the Center for International Health Research.

Name: Pending AI
Description: Pending AI has developed a comprehensive discovery platform enabled by artificial intelligence and quantum mechanics, ushering in a new paradigm of medicinal innovation where higher-quality small molecule drugs can be developed in a fraction of the time and cost.

Name: Pressure BioSciences, Inc.
Description: We are a life sciences company focused on the development and commercialization of a novel, enabling, platform technology called pressure cycling technology ("PCT"). PCT uses cycles of hydrostatic pressure between ambient and ultra-high levels (up to 35,000 psi and greater) to control bio-molecular interactions.

Name: New England Fertility Society
Description: New England Fertility Society is a biotechnology company based out of 110 Patricia Dr, Tewksbury, Massachusetts, United States.

Name: RootPath
Description: RootPath is a synthetic biology company that elevates the throughput of gene function interrogation by orders of magnitude.  Our molecular programming-based DNA fragment assembly technology gives life science researchers, drug developers and synthetic biologists unprecedented access to accurate, long synthetic genes and their functional readouts. We enable biology at scale.

Name: Kanyos Bio
Description:
Kanyos Bio was founded with the goal of developing antigen-specific immune tolerance technology for two specific autoimmune indications, type-1 diabetes and celiac disease.

Our technology originated at EPFL (Ecole Polytechnique Fédérale Lausanne) in Switzerland with our sister company, Anokion.  Kanyos and Anokion are collaborating in this effort with Astellas Pharma, Inc. (“Astellas”).  As an independent affiliate, Kanyos aims to develop antigen-specific, disease-modifying therapies for patients with type-1 diabetes and celiac disease by leveraging the immunotechnology expertise of Anokion and the clinical translation experience of Astellas.

Name: Artelligence Therapeutics
Description:
Improve the efficiency and speed of drug design & discovery process by utilizing molecular modeling & molecular dynamics simulation software to understand the molecular mechanisms underlying the biological activity of drug targets and design molecular entities that are more likely to be active.

Services:
• Drug Discovery & Medicinal Chemistry Strategies:
     - Hit Identification.
     - Lead Optimization.
     - Bioisosteric Replacement.
     - Prodrug Approaches.
     - Peptidomimetics Design.
• In Silico / Computer-Aided Drug Design (CADD) Techniques:
     - Ligand-Based Drug Design: QSAR & Pharmacophore Modeling.
     - Structure-Based Drug Design: Docking & Fragment-Based Drug Discovery.
     - Artificial Intelligence-Based De Novo Drug Design: Deep Learning.

• Cheminformatics Tools: Machine Learning (AI) & Data Mining.

Name: Red Queen Therapeutics
Description:
Red Queen Therapeutics is a clinical-stage company working to deliver important and accessible new treatment options for a broad range of virus-borne illnesses including influenzas, coronaviruses, and other current and emerging pathogens.

Co-founded by Apple Tree Partners (ATP) and biomedical researcher Loren Walensky, M.D., Ph.D., Red Queen is applying its proprietary stapled lipopeptide technology to develop and deliver new treatments for a broad range of viruses, including coronaviruses, influenzas, and other enveloped viruses. For more information, please visit redqueentx.com.

Name: BioAnalytix
Description: BioAnalytix works with leading biotherapeutic companies in the development and application of advanced analytics and data analysis of complex biologics, from candidate selection through regulatory package development. Applying state of the art mass spectrometry, biophysical analytics, and method development expertise, our team of PhDs provides precise data packages for specific project needs through all stages of biotherapeutic drug development, and we further offer our insights and understanding of CMC and regulatory requirements to support product development from IND through BLA.

Name: KEW, Inc.
Description:
KEW, Inc. is a comprehensive genomic profiling company, dedicated to revolutionizing cancer care by providing therapeutic options based on an individual patient’s tumor genetic profile with CANCERPLEX, our flagship clinical product for identifying genetic variants and matching them with targeted therapies in solid tumors. Based in Cambridge, MA, KEW was founded by pioneers of the precision medicine industry, including key contributors to the Human Genome and The Cancer Genome Atlas projects.

As increasing evidence puts precision medicine at the forefront in the fight against cancer, we have recognized the growing need for expanded patient access to comprehensive genomic profiling to guide better treatment decisions and quality patient care in local community practice. To address this critical, unmet need, we are now partnering with and enabling molecular labs to expand their precision medicine programs to adopt CANCERPLEX for optimal cancer care in their local laboratories.

We couldn't have done it without our top-notch staff. You can view all of our career opportunities at www.kewinc.com/careers

Name: MimiVax, Inc.
Description:
Our vision, to disrupt cancer with the development of highly innovative immunotherapies aimed at increasing patient survival rates

MimiVax is a privately held, clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on the development and commercialization of immunotherapeutic vaccines and targeted therapies for the treatment of cancer. 

SurVaxM, our lead immunotherapeutic vaccine, has completed a Phase 2a clinical trial in adults with newly diagnosed glioblastoma. 

Additional indications are being evaluated through: 
- Phase 1 clinical trials in multiple myeloma combination with REVLIMID (lenalidomide) 
- Phase 1 in Neuro-Endocrine Tumors (NET)
- Pilot Study in Pediatric High Grade Glioma, recurrent/relapsed Medulloblastoma and DIPG

Name: Singulomics Corporation
Description: Singulomics, established in New York in 2016, is a privately-held biotechnology company that aims to transform single-cell omics research and unlock its many applications in biology and medicine. Building on the unmatched expertise in single-cell genomics, transcriptomic, and epigenomics developed since the mid-2000s at Albert Einstein College of Medicine, we develop and provide high-quality, innovative single-cell and spatial multiomics services to academic and industrial communities around the world.

Name: Genetic Leap
Description:
Genetic Leap is a clinical-stage biotech company innovating at the cutting edge of AI and RNA genetic medicine for in vivo reprogramming with oral medicines to address the health needs of millions of people living with diseases that modern medicine has been powerless against, until now.  

RNA is the central orchestrator of biology. Genetic Leap’s AI platform is proven to successfully reprogram RNA at its sequence using oligonucleotides or at its structure using small molecules, enabling a new generation of powerful, safe, and efficacious drugs.
Location: New York, New York, United States

Name: Akttyva Therapeutics
Description: Akttyva Therapeutics, Inc. is an NSF-funded company focused on discovery and development of therapies for unmet medical needs using a suite of proprietary computational tools and unique compound libraries.

Name: Aphios Corporation
Description:
We are leading the way in developing green, enabling biotechnology and nanotechnology drug delivery platforms and enhanced therapeutic products for health maintenance, disease prevention and the treatment of certain cancers, infectious diseases and Central Nervous System (CNS) disorders such as Alzheimer's Disease.
 
Aphios, which means "virus-free" in Greek, was founded in 1993 as a Delaware C corporation. The company was founded by Dr. Trevor P. Castor, President and CEO, to develop enabling technology platforms around the delivery and viral safety of biologics such as human plasma and recombinant therapeutics, hence its "virus-free" name. At its founding, the Company elected to spend about 10% of its research activities on investigating natural therapeutics. This interest has evolved to the realization that in order to solve the problems of cancer and aging, we have to look to nature, marine organisms and terrestrial plants that have learned how to control cell growth and cancerous mutation, often living for hundreds to thousands of years.

Name: Precigenetics
Description: See unseen biology

Name: Aaron Diamond AIDS Research Center
Description: The Aaron Diamond AIDS Research Center, the world’s largest private HIV/AIDS research center, is committed to finding solutions to end the AIDS epidemic by conducting basic discovery research and by developing novel therapies, vaccines and other prevention strategies.
Location: New York, New York, United States

Name: Ceramedix, Inc. (EFL ‘25)
Description:
Ceramedix is a growing, privately- and government- funded biopharmaceutical company developing a new class of endothelial tissue protection and repair medicines pioneered by leading scientific and clinical experts in these areas. 

Our scientific founders at Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center in New York and our Chief Scientific Officer have formed a deep, mechanistic understanding of a novel signaling biology that drives tissue injury in a broad range of medically relevant settings.

We believe our drug candidates will have application for treating multiple disease stresses that lead to organ failure, including those that affect the vascular endothelium of the eye, lung, kidney, and other organs.  We are located in New York City.
Location: New York, New York, United States

Name: Nobias Therapeutics
Description: Nobias Therapeutics is a clinical-stage company developing novel small molecule therapeutics for rare diseases. Our unique access to rich genomic and health datasets and strong relationships with pediatric academic medical centers across North America allow us to rapidly advance drug discovery for genetically-defined rare diseases, with an initial focus on pediatric indications, but expansion opportunities in adults and non-rare indications.

Name: Gold Standard Diagnostics Horsham, LLC
Description: Gold Standard Diagnostics Horsham (formerly Abraxis) is a respected provider of rapid testing solutions to customers in the environmental, water quality, food, agriculture and life science industries. We offer kits in ELISA plate and tube formats as well as lateral flow test strips, magnetic particle assays, protein phosphatase inhibition assays (PPIA). Find out more at www.abraxiskits.com.

Name: Abzyme Therapeutics
Description:
Abzyme Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing modular single domain VHH antibody fragments for immunotherapy using proprietary antibody generation platforms. The company is located in the Eastern Pennsylvania biotechnology/pharmaceutical hub 30-miles west of Philadelphia.

Our decision support platform designed for COVID-19 can deliver test kit savings of up to 70%, enabling up to a 300% increase in sample analysis capacity. With wePool AI, we can scale COVID-19 testing and help labs meet the otherwise-overwhelming demand as the pandemic spreads.

Powered by AI, wePool's platform predicts an individual sample’s likelihood for testing positive for COVID-19, and segments test populations into distinct groups, or “pools,” to enable fast and efficient testing. Leveraging pooled testing which has demonstrated efficacy historically for disease outbreak management, wePool’s AI uses sociodemographic and healthcare data as inputs to intelligently arrange pools of predictably negative samples and separate predictably positive samples. The technology can be applied for PCR, Antibody, Antigen, Next Generation Sequencing, and other infectious disease testing assays (e.g. Influenza A/B, Malaria, HIV, HPV, and others). Name: Allied Microbiota
Description:
Harvesting the power of Nature, Allied Microbiota develops advanced microbes to clean-up environmental contamination faster, more sustainably, and more cost-effectively than traditional remediation methods.  Our products tackle the toughest contaminants like those from manufactured gas plants, chlorinated organics, and even emerging contaminants like per- and poly-fluoroalkyl substances (PFAS). 

We developed a heat-loving microbe called ThermO+ that breaks down contaminants at a fraction of the cost and significantly faster than traditional methods.  Powered by heat and on oxygen, our microbes can clean difficult contaminants such as chlorinated compounds like polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs), petroleum products, and dioxins from the soil, turning brownfields into greenfields.   We don’t bury the problem. We solve it. 

Site cleans ups can be expensive, but our technology makes this possible for companies, developers, and communities. We aim and strive to create cleaner, healthier, and productive areas around the world. Make Allied Microbiota your fast, affordable, and go-to solution for a cleaner tomorrow.

CILA THERAPEUTICS is dedicated to respiratory health and focused on innovative treatments to help patients breathe easily and protect their lungs from irreversible damage. We own 100% of the robust IP portfolio that will generate value for investors and patients through the development of: 
1.	First-in-class, novel, inhaled therapeutics (de-risked) for the treatment of Airway Obstructive Pulmonary Diseases (AOPD) including COPD, Bronchiectasis, severe Asthma, Cystic fibrosis, and more to address a critical unmet need for ~20 million patients in the US and > 200 million globally. CILA’s team has a successful track record with broad and diverse experience in patient care, drug discovery, development, manufacturing, commercialization, and reimbursement. We're a new startup with a transformational technology for the future of biology, biochemistry, and synthetic biology. We're in active development, looking for funding and partners to help us build the future.

With these formulation and molecule advancements in place, ViaClean Technologies LLC was established in 2018 as a new biotech company with exclusive rights to these patents. Pitri utilizes novel fungal strains and green chemistry to deliver vibrant, long-lasting colors that are better for both our bodies and our environment, while revolutionizing the beauty industry.

Pitri is developing a suite of biofabricated colorants for beauty and personal care products, with a focus on an animal-free carmine alternative.

Name: Prisma
Description:
The Digital Proteome: Unveiling the Final Frontier of Biology

Prisma is advancing breakthrough protein sequencing technologies to unveil the true functional drivers of biology and transform human health.

Imagine a world where we can resolve every protein within a sample, revealing its identity and quantity with stunning resolution. 

This is the future Prisma is building with unbiased, single-molecule protein sequencing, a revolutionary approach that analyzes proteins for hypothesis free discovery.

Th BioRxiv article in our featured post dives into the core of Prisma's elegant protein sequencing technology.  Our Universal Recognizer is a single, small molecule dye that binds directly to the N-terminus of proteins and produces a distinct optical fingerprint for each amino acid and post-translational modification. Combined with our cutting-edge, light-based sequencing approach, Prisma generates accurate amino acid sequences to enable unbiased, proteome-scale identification and quantification of proteins at the single-molecule level.

Description:
TellBio, Inc is a development stage biotechnology company based in Beverly, Massachusetts, with the goal to revolutionize the detection and treatment of cancer through its unique and proprietary circulating tumor cells (CTCs) technology and complementary therapeutic platform, TellDx and TellRx, respectively.  The foundation of the Company’s approach – detection of and targeting CTCs – is exclusively licensed from Massachusetts General Hospital and is based on decades of academic and clinical research. TellBio’s vision is to free patients and their families from the tyranny of cancer via both its TellDx and TellRx platforms.

TellDx is a fully functional diagnostic solution aimed at detecting live CTCs from patient liquid biopsies. TellRx is the therapeutics platform that generates novel anti-cancer medicines by specifically targeting CTCs. Description:

Cancer metastasis is the primary cause of over 90% of cancer deaths and yet there is no drug specifically and directly targeting metastasis on the market today. Novita aims to address this problem by developing inhibitors of fascin, a key protein highly expressed in tumor cells and critically involved in cell motility and the metastasis of multiple tumor types. 

Additionally, fascin is also highly expressed in antigen-presenting cells within the tumor microenvironment and fascin inhibitor, in combination with immune checkpoint inhibitors, can synergistically increase anti-tumor immune response.

In 2021, STEAM Box explored Mental Wellness through our podcast format linking our youth with young wellness experts of color.  This was a triumph as youth discussed loss, grief, rage and tragedy but always came back to the importance of ‘hope’.

The initial development program for lasmiditan will address the major unmet need of migraine patients with risk factors for cardiovascular disease and those with stable cardiovascular disease. The first Phase 3 Trial, under agreement with the FDA on a Special Protocol Assessment, includes this patient population as well as two novel endpoints for approval of acute treatment of migraine. 

CoLucid has successfully completed seven clinical studies for lasmiditan, including a Phase 2b study treating a single migraine attack in 391 patients. Lasmiditan achieved its primary endpoint of reducing a moderate or severe headache at baseline to mild or none 2 hours after dosing (p<0.0001). Lasmiditan also achieved numerous secondary endpoints and was well tolerated at all doses. No evidence of drug-related cardiovascular adverse effects or chest symptoms has been reported.

Description:
We know that clinically valuable information from the tumor genome is waiting to be discovered. By combining cutting-edge genome analysis with the latest technological breakthroughs in AI we develop analytical tools delivering key answers to patients and clinicians.

At MNM, our goal has always been to understand cancer and find the right therapy for every patient. We set out on this journey analyzing somatic variants of patient tumors to guide their therapy. Soon, we realized that there is much more valuable information than only a coding DNA sequence in the patient’s tumor; however, we needed more genomes with clinical data to fully understand cancer origins. We started a BioBank and began building the database of whole-genome sequencing data, which led to the creation of custom data processing pipelines, distributed computation, and storing results in the cloud. With rich datasets at hand, now we can use machine learning to drive our success. We have developed and patented custom CDK4/6i, HRD, and PD1i patient stratification algorithms. The analysis of patient response to existing therapies inspired our broader vision We have realized that our genome analysis technology can reveal patterns of cancer mutations related to genes that are not yet targeted by any therapy. It is this realization that lies at the heart of our unique approach. We do not follow a classical drug target discovery approach - from basic science to in vitro models and clinical trials. Our solution starts from real patient data and leverage AI and bioinformatics to understand mutation profiles and find relevant target candidates. And we are already doing it by creating our drug - MNM177!

To follow this path, we are building a unique field that unites life scientists and data scientists. Together, we can answer questions at the core of cancer development. Together, we can find the right therapy for every cancer patient.

Name: Sistemic Ltd
Description:
Sistemic is a product development company that leverages the instructive power of microRNA (miRNA) to provide leading-edge products for the Bioprocessing, Cell (and Stem Cell) Therapy, and Drug Discovery and Development markets. Sistemic provides a broad range of products from robust quality control (QC) for cells to toxicity and drug response based products for Pharmaceutical markets. These products are helping companies worldwide to deliver drugs and therapies successfully and in a cost-effective manner,whilst providing knowledge-rich and instructive data on a range of cell systems.

Sistemic’s pioneering products are centred around the company’s IP and core expertise within three areas: robust miRNA profiling, superior statistical analytics and multi-layered contextual analysis. Together,these constitute the Sistemic Methodology. 

Sistemic leverages the instructive power of miRNA. MiRNAs are seen as the master controllers of a cell and provide information on the effects within a whole cell or organism rather than an isolated pathway. This systems approach means that the data produced is more indicative of the biology and more informative of actual effect. 

The Sistemic method provides a rigorous yet rapid understanding of the biological changes that occur within a cell. Resulting data allow companies to make well-informed decisions. This enables them to develop their cell (or stem cell) therapies and drug development pipelines more successfully and more cost effectively.

Name: Adeptrix Corporation
Description:
Adeptrix provides discovery focused bioanalytical services that enable high resolution molecular profiling from liquid biopsies using extracellular vesicles (EVs). Our core platform, exoBAMSTM, combines precision immunoaffinity EV enrichment with multiparametric MALDI mass spectrometry to reveal biologically meaningful signals that are often lost in conventional biofluid analysis.  

We support pharma, biotech, clinical research organizations, and academic groups with services spanning exploratory biomarker discovery, disease biology studies, translational research, and pilot screening studies—across oncology and other complex disease areas. exoBAMSTM is designed for research use only (RUO) and integrates seamlessly with existing biofluid samples and MALDI MS workflows.  

What sets Adeptrix apart is our ability to selectively isolate disease  or tissue relevant EV populations before analysis. Instead of measuring diluted signals from bulk biofluids, we enrich the biology at the source—enabling clearer molecular readouts, improved reproducibility, and biologically interpretable results. This approach bridges the gap between solid tissue biology and liquid biopsies, providing functional, cell of origin insight rather than indirect markers alone.  

Adeptrix is built for discovery driven collaboration, offering flexible pilot studies and scalable workflows that help teams test hypotheses, prioritize biomarkers, and de risk early research decisions.

Name: PALADIN Consortium
Description:
A novel consortium working to become a central place for PAGs and Industry to collaborate to transform the pace of medicine’s development.
~
In recent years, through forums like FDA Patient-Focused Drug Development meetings and social media, patient communities and their families are calling upon their advocacy organizations, health care providers, drug developers and the clinical research enterprise to communicate and collaborate more effectively in order to accelerate the development of new therapies, with the ultimate goal of increasing access to life-saving treatments.

The launch of PALADIN is an exciting and important step to establish more effective relationships between patient advocacy groups and industry. We look forward to working together to develop consensus-based guidelines, training, resources and competencies that will optimize patient advocacy group- biopharmaceutical company collaborations. Ultimately, we believe PALADIN’s impact will enable more consistent, effective and efficient engagements that accelerate the development of new medical therapies and better align medicines development with patient needs.

It is our hope that PALADIN will continue to innovate and support advocacy-industry collaborations well beyond its launch year. While the focus for year 1 is on the US ecosystem, the Consortia members believe there will be a future opportunity to leverage learnings to other countries and adjust for local regulations and laws.

Name: Aseman

Additive manufacturing is a large sector with enormous untapped potentials. We look at all the companies working on AM as our possible collaborators not competitors.

Description:
Aviva Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on advancing hormone-based medicine. We aim to unlock the potential of hormone therapies through precision drug design, targeting patient populations with significant unmet medical needs.

Historically, the clinical use of testosterone has been constrained because it converts into estrogen through a process called aromatization. Aviva Bio’s lead therapeutic program, AVA-291 (d3-Testosterone), is designed to preserve androgen activity while resisting aromatization.

d3-Testosterone: Re-engineered Testosterone

The Problem

Standard testosterone therapy can convert into estradiol through aromatization. 

This conversion has been associated with clinical risks such as:

--Gynecomastia in men (aka "man boobs")
--Increased breast cancer risk in women

These risks have historically limited the clinical development of testosterone-based treatments.

The Gap

Testosterone plays an important physiological role in:

--Libido
--Muscle mass
--Energy levels
--Metabolic health
--Overall quality of life

However, safety concerns associated with aromatization have constrained the development of therapies based on testosterone.

The Solution

d3-Testosterone (d3-T) is an investigational androgen therapy designed to retain the beneficial effects of testosterone while resisting aromatization.

The compound is structurally identical to testosterone except that certain hydrogen atoms are replaced with deuterium, a naturally occurring isotope.

This molecular modification is designed to:

--Maintain androgen receptor activity
--Prevent conversion into estradiol
--Enable safer androgen therapy across different clinical contexts.

Description:
EQGen Biomedical is developing a proprietary, next-generation stem cell treatment for equine osteoarthritis and musculoskeletal disease. The existing platform technology leverages a proprietary method to purify pluripotent stem cell populations with the potential to treat equine inflammatory and degenerative joint disease as a true Disease Modifying Osteoarthritis Drug (DMOAD). Future product development will utilize the same innovation for use in canines and camelids. 

As a targeted FDA and EMA‐approved therapy which truly modifies underlying joint disease in animals, our technology represents a profound shift in veterinary industry, not merely an incremental upgrade in OA symptom management. 

Osteoarthritis (OA) is a leading cause of equine lameness. As in humans, OA is a chronic degenerative disease involving the entire joint. Because cartilage has no or minimal ability for intrinsic repair, OA destruction of the cartilage cannot be reversed. The result is painful joints with crepitation, decreased range of motion and loss of performance.

Current clinical management targets symptomatic pain relief and reduction of joint inflammation. Commonly used medications, synthetic compounds, and existing allogeneic or autologous treatments are inadequate with no or limited regenerative ability. EQGen Biomedical is developing an off-the-shelf, cost-effective stem cell product which eliminates the need for blood or tissue harvest from patients and requires no product preparation. Unlike other therapies, our solution is being engineered as a true disease modifying drug which has the potential to reverse the course of OA progression.

Our seasoned leadership team brings proven skill in the commercialization of regenerative medicine products for equine and companion animal use, with deep industry experience from Wyeth, Lilly, Pfizer, Merck Animal Health, and commercial-stage regenerative companies with products used in more than 40k horses and dogs to date.

Description:
Polyose Bio uses the power of synthetic biology to cheaply and sustainably transform food waste into high-value chemicals.

On a global level, 40% of the food that is produced goes to waste. In the U.S. alone, that amounts to 100 million tons of food waste every year, which contributes 5% of the U.S. greenhouse gas emissions. The worst part is that a large portion of this food waste goes straight to landfills, where it decomposes and releases methane, a potent greenhouse gas.

At Polyose Bio, we are completely redefining what it means to upcycle food waste. We use synthetic biology to enable a first-of-its-kind pairing between insects and highly engineered microbial cell factories to dramatically reduce the cost and environmental impact of food waste processing and upcycling. Our novel process transforms raw food waste into specialty chemicals such as sugar polymers that sell for hundreds of dollars per kilogram. 

Not only are we using food waste as our raw material, we are also displacing very unsustainable production methods that are used to supply the $100 billion sugar polymer industry today. As a result, we can reduce the carbon footprint of sugar polymer production by 95%. And we do this all at a fraction of the cost.

Description:
Novastra Therapeutics is a Boston-headquartered, clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering Next-Generation Immune Reprogramming Therapy (XIRT) for solid tumors. We are engineering a paradigm shift beyond traditional cancer vaccines to deliver a system-level immune reset. While current immunotherapies often fail due to the complexity of the Tumor Microenvironment, Novastra’s approach is designed to overcome the full spectrum of resistance phenotypes. This includes addressing the "immune desert" where T-cells are absent, breaching physical "immune exclusion" barriers, and revitalizing the "functional desert"—a critical state where immune cells are present but rendered metabolically exhausted and dysfunctional.

At the core of our pipeline is the OmniAntigenTM Platform (OAP). Utilizing our proprietary metal-organic nanocloak technology, we convert a patient’s own tumor cells into a potent, multi-valent therapeutic in a same-day, hospital-ready process. Unlike standard approaches that rely on prediction, our supramolecular assembly instantly preserves the patient’s entire tumor antigen repertoire while co-delivering potent STING pathway agonists directly to dendritic cells. This unique surface engineering re-educates the immune system to break tolerance and spark a robust, adaptive response.

Our lead program, OAP-101, is actively advancing in clinical trials for checkpoint-inhibitor-refractory solid tumors. To maintain high-velocity execution, Novastra operates with a strategic global footprint: we anchor our innovation and corporate strategy in Boston/Cambridge, while leveraging a dedicated business operations and clinical center in Shanghai. This dual-engine structure allows us to accelerate data generation and redefine clinical outcomes for the hardest-to-treat cancers.

Using a novel, high-resolution method to resolve all the cells that together comprise the tumour micro-environment, we are able to infer important inter-cellular connections that may protect the tumor from an immune assault.
By combining many patient tumor-immune networks, we at Pyxis, can predict IO drug response for many cancer types. Our platform can also suggest alternative treatment routes in cases where the predicted drug response is low, improving the quality of life of oncological patients.

Description:
PhoenixBio established its proprietary chimeric mouse model, the PXB-mouse, with a highly humanized liver through years of research and development. With the addition of fresh, isolated human hepatocytes, PXB-cells, the applications of our products and study services are as wide-ranging as our clients’ research goals. 

The PXB-mouse animal background (cDNA-uPA/SCID) makes for a robust, consistent model that maintains up to 95% stable human hepatocyte engraftment. The reconstituted humanized liver features structural and biological characteristics commonly observed in normal human livers. 

The model has proven to be a world-wide gold standard for Hepatitis B Virus (HBV) and Hepatitis C Virus (HCV) research, but usage is expanding in the fields of:

.        Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics,
·        Human Specific Hepatotoxicity,
·        Oligonucleotide and Gene-based Therapeutics,
·        HBV & HBV/HDV,
·        NASH/NAFLD,
·        Other human liver-related research fields.

PXB-cells are approximately 95% pure human hepatocytes freshly isolated from the PXB-mouse. They feature long-term stability of up to 40 days, and allow for consistent supply from the same donor. One unique feature of PXB-cells and PXB-mice is the ability to directly compare in vitro and in vitro data from the same human donor.
 
With over 300 scientific publications to its credit, the PXB-mouse is the world’s most widely used chimeric mouse model with a humanized liver. A high replacement index, lifespan of up to 2 years, and no secondary drug to maintain mouse liver injury means that your data can translate better to humans than ever before.

Please visit our website at https://www.phoenixbio.com/ to learn more about our model and inquire about our offered products and services.

Laboratory-based diagnostics are expensive, to the individual, the insurer, and the system. By lowering the price of modern diagnostics, we dramatically increase their use and value within healthcare.

ACCURACY
The Senzo Amplified Lateral Flow test is PCR-accurate. This means that for the first time we can bring testing for a range of new infections and diseases out of the laboratory and closer to the patient enabling a revolution in both diagnostics and treatments.

SIMPLICITY
Current diagnostics are too complex. From appointments to samples to laboratories to results. By simplifying diagnostics and bringing accurate and real-time testing to the patient, we can save money, save resources and save lives.

SPEED
Testing is about accurate results. The faster we can return a diagnosis, the sooner we can begin a treatment. Currently, patients and health care professionals often wait days for results. Real-time testing changes this forever, removing the gaps between consultation, testing, data and treatment.

ACCESSIBILITY
Accurate diagnostics today remain unevenly distributed. The only way to bring testing to patients in lower-income areas is to replace the complex central laboratory model with an affordable point-of-care diagnostics system without sacrificing accuracy.

The Problem: Drug Discovery's Fundamental Challenges
Traditional drug development is inefficient, costly, and fails in over 90% of cases—primarily because early predictions rarely translate to clinical success
Current computational approaches like AlphaFold 3 excel at modeling specific interactions (like drug-protein binding) but fail to capture the intricate network of biological interactions that determine real-world therapeutic outcomes
Promising candidates routinely fail in late-stage clinical trials due to unforeseen toxicity or limited efficacy, after substantial investment
The Solution: A Programmable Virtual Human (PVH)
PVH creates comprehensive simulations of human biology that enable researchers to:
Predict therapeutic responses with unprecedented accuracy before entering clinical testing
Identify potential adverse effects and toxicity profiles during early development stages
Engineer molecules with optimized therapeutic indices—maximizing efficacy while minimizing harm
Close the critical gap between preclinical research and clinical outcomes

By integrating advances in artificial intelligence, high-throughput experimental biology, single-cell analytics, and real-world evidence, PVH functions as a "biological compiler" for drug discovery. Rather than iterating through countless design cycles, it systematically identifies the optimal therapeutic intervention to restore homeostasis based on sophisticated virtual human mode

-Identified an Editing Enzyme present in immune system 
-Determined that HIV inhibits this Editing Enzyme as a vital part of the infection cycle 
-Demonstrated that allowing this Editing Enzyme to function halts HIV

Currently, many cancer drugs are developed without fully understanding how they impact the genome. BreakSight fills this gap by providing detailed insights into how DNA damage occurs in response to different therapies. These insights can help drug developers make better decisions earlier in the process, potentially improving the success rate of new treatments.

Why are these discoveries pivotal? Data generated by our platform can:
1.	Reveal a drug’s unique effect on the cancer genome and sequence-specific mechanisms of genomic instability
2.	Measure successful drug-target engagement at the genomic level
3.	Pinpoint new DNA sequence biomarkers of drug efficacy that resides in the 98% of the genome left unexplored
4.	Offer deeper DNA damage insights that might identify new therapeutic targets

Our services:

- DDsite
o	Tagging, retrieving, and sequencing DNA double-strand break sites across the genome from cells exposed to treatment(s) that induces DNA damage

- DDinsight
o	Analysis of sequenced data through our stringent analysis pipeline to pinpoint reproducible sites of breakage across the genome
o	Comparison of break sites across conditions

- DDinsight+
o	Uncovering DNA repeats and sequence motifs that are enriched across identified DNA break sites
o	Assessing the overlap of DNA break sites with other genomic elements and characteristics to discovery any significant associations

- DDsite-Cyto
o	Tagging, retrieving, and sequencing DNA double-strand break fragments present specifically in the cytoplasm of cells exposed to treatment(s) that induces DNA damage

Name: NeuroSkye Therapeutics Inc.
Description:
NeuroSkye Therapeutics develops human blood-brain barrier (BBB) and blood-tumor barrier (BTB) platforms that generate the human CNS delivery evidence needed to make better development decisions earlier.

Whether a therapeutic can reliably reach the human brain remains one of the defining questions in CNS drug development. NeuroSkye generates quantitative, human-relevant evidence of BBB penetration, transport, efflux, retention, and barrier integrity - helping teams prioritize candidates with favorable CNS transport properties, benchmark novel delivery technologies against clinically validated and sponsor-selected comparator molecules, and make more informed decisions before major preclinical investments.

Our modular BBB and BTB assembloid platforms support small molecules, peptides, antibodies, oligonucleotides, nanoparticles, viral vectors, and emerging CNS delivery technologies within a unified experimental framework.

Our mission is to make human CNS delivery evidence a standard for CNS development decisions. 

Every CNS program presents unique delivery challenges. These are some of the questions NeuroSkye helps answer:

- Can my therapeutic reach the brain?
Quantify BBB penetration, permeability, efflux, retention, and barrier integrity using human BBB assembloids.

-How does it cross the BBB?
Characterize transport mechanisms, including receptor-mediated transport, passive diffusion, active efflux, and concentration-dependent behavior.

- Does it reach brain tumors?
Compare transport across human BBB and blood-tumor barrier (BTB) models.

- Did the therapeutic cargo reach its target?
Evaluate functional delivery using downstream biological readouts where appropriate.

- How does it compare with existing delivery strategies?
Benchmark novel CNS delivery technologies against published/clinically validated and sponsor-selected comparator molecules.

Have a different CNS delivery question? Contact us to discuss how NeuroSkye can support your program.

Ang-(1-7), the active ingredient in Constant’s product, TXA127, has been shown to have multiple biologic effects:
-stimulating endothelial progenitor cells
-stimulating muscle satellite cells
-stimulating oligodendrocyte progenitor cells
-reducing oxidative stress and ROS,
-restoring the integrity of epithelial and endothelial surfaces,
-reducing inflammation by reversing the increased permeability of the blood vessels caused by the virus; thereby preventing movement of inflammatory cells into tissue leading to the “cytokine storm,”
-reducing apoptosis,
-inhibiting coagulopathy, and
-reducing fibrosis through down-regulation of the TGF beta pathway.

Ang-(1-7) has been shown to have positive outcomes in a number of animal models of stroke, heart disease, and muscle dystrophies. In addition, in several disease models it has become clear that blocking the effect of Ang-(1-7) is detrimental.

Description:
Lucerna, Inc. is addressing the $9 billion early-stage drug discovery failure problem with an RNA-focused approach.  Traditional protein-centric methods target only 0.05% of the human genome, whereas our technology unlocks access to over 70%—vastly expanding drug discovery opportunities.  Our mission is to develop faster, cost-efficient tools that make disease-modifying RNAs both “visible” and “druggable,” increasing the chances of treating diseases with unmet medical needs.

Lucerna offers innovative RNA-focused research reagents powered by our proprietary fluorogenic RNA (SpinachTM) technology. Our robust, user-friendly imaging solutions provide real-time RNA visualization in live cells—enabling seamless integration across microscopy, flow cytometry, and high-content imaging platforms. Designed specifically for RNA-focused drug discovery, Lucerna’s innovative products address critical gaps in early-stage drug discovery. Name: MetaVia
Description:
MetaVia (Nasdaq: MTVA) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on transforming cardiometabolic diseases. MetaVia is currently developing DA-1726 for the treatment of obesity, and is developing vanoglipel (DA-1241) for the treatment of Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis (MASH).

DA-1726 is a novel, dual oxyntomodulin (OXM) analog agonist that functions as a glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor (GLP1R) and glucagon receptor (GCGR), for once-a-week injection. OXM is a naturally-occurring gut hormone that activates GLP1R and GCGR, thereby decreasing food intake while increasing energy expenditure, thus potentially resulting in superior body weight loss compared to selective GLP1R agonists. In a Phase 1 multiple ascending dose (MAD) trial in obesity, DA-1726 demonstrated best-in-class potential for weight loss, glucose control, and waist reduction. Vanoglipel is a novel G-protein-coupled receptor 119 (GPR119) agonist that promotes the release of key gut peptides GLP-1, GIP, and PYY. In pre-clinical studies, vanoglipel demonstrated a positive effect on liver inflammation, lipid metabolism, weight loss, and glucose metabolism, reducing hepatic steatosis, hepatic inflammation, and liver fibrosis, while also improving glucose control. In a Phase 2a clinical study, vanoglipel demonstrated direct hepatic action in addition to its glucose lowering effects.

Our strategic partner and the largest investor, Dong-A ST Co. Ltd., is part of the Dong-A Socio Group of companies established in 1932 and based in South Korea. MetaVia has the full support of Dong-A ST’s Research center, providing the company with access to R&D, scientific and CMC expertise.

Name: SnapGene
Description:
SnapGene is molecular biology software for designing, visualising, annotating, and documenting DNA sequences and cloning workflows. It is used by research scientists, graduate students, and biotech and pharma R&D teams who design and manipulate DNA constructs in the lab.

SnapGene was built to address a specific problem: molecular biologists were spending significant time on avoidable cloning mistakes, and records of cloning procedures were often incomplete or missing entirely. The software was designed to be easier to use than pen and paper, so that researchers plan and document their work digitally as a natural part of the process, not as an extra step.

Supported workflows include:

* Plasmid design and annotation
* Cloning simulation: Gibson Assembly, Golden Gate, restriction cloning, TOPO, Gateway, NEBuilder, TA/GC, and In-Fusion cloning
* Primer visualisation with Tm calculations and binding site display
* Trace file alignment to reference sequences
* PCR and agarose gel simulation
* Automatic protocol and graphical procedure history generation

SnapGene runs on Mac, Windows, and Ubuntu, and is available as a full-featured application or as SnapGene Viewer, a free tool for opening and sharing annotated sequence files. It was developed with support from NIH Phase I and II SBIR grants. SnapGene is part of the Dotmatics portfolio of scientific software.

Name: AlphaThera
Description:
AlphaThera is a US based biotechnology company specializing in antibody labeling reagents. The company developed a unique, site-specific bioconjugation method that enhances assay performance over competing labeling methods.

The company was founded by Dr Andrew Tsourkas and Dr. James Hui at the University of Pennsylvania in 2016. They developed the technology of LASIC (Light Assisted Site-specific Conjugation), which led to the creation of oYo-Link antibody labeling reagents.

oYo-Link reagents enable rapid, covalent, site-specific antibody labeling to a wide range of cargos (e.g. biotin, azide, oligos, fluorescent proteins and more) in just 2 steps - mix and illuminate. Conjugation requires less than 30 seconds hands-on time, and is complete in 2 hours. 

Unlike other labeling technologies available commercially, no antibody purification is required, as oYo-Link is compatible with all common buffers, including those containing BSA, Tris and Azide, so researchers save valuable time and materials. Furthermore, oYo-Link enables conjugation with as little as 1μg of antibody at concentrations as low as 50μg/mL.

AlphaThera's also provides Conjugation Services to researchers that would prefer to outsource their antibody conjugation. 

AlphaThera’s mission is to remove the complexity and inconsistency that has long been associated with antibody conjugations, making labeling simple, fast and site-specific.

Every year, hundreds of domain-expert scientists — post-docs, principal investigators, translational researchers — identify a therapeutic target they believe could be the foundation of a category-defining cell therapy company. Most of them never find out whether they're right. The systematic evaluation that pharma R&D departments run in-house, and that consulting firms charge $50K–$250K to deliver over 8–16 weeks, is priced out of reach for the pre-funded founder. The free public databases — OpenTargets, DepMap, the Human Protein Atlas, Cell Surface Protein Atlas, ClinicalTrials.gov — provide the raw material but require weeks of manual integration to produce investor-grade evidence.

We built Ligant.ai to close that gap.

Our platform acts as a virtual Head of Target Assessment: a multi-agent AI system that queries 20+ authoritative biomedical databases in parallel, synthesizes the evidence across genetics, expression, safety, competition, and commercial viability, and produces a structured, citation-grounded dossier a founder can defend to investors.

Three principles are non-negotiable:

- Provenance-first. Every claim traces to a timestamped source query. No parametric guessing.
- Glass-box transparency. Every agent step, tool call, and confidence level is visible to the founder.
- Human decision gates. The platform presents the evidence. The founder decides — build, kill, or pivot.

We built Ligant for the scientist who already believes. Our job is to pressure-test that belief against every dimension that matters for company formation — honestly, including the evidence that might kill the thesis.

Chemical Testing Alone Cannot Anticipate the Potency of Full Spectrum Products

non-psychotropic cannabinoids and terpenes, percent composition cannot predict how the

certainly cannot predict how multiple agonist and antagonist compounds within broad or full
spectrum products might affect patients. The industry needs to adopt the standards
comparable to how drug potency is measured and expressed throughout the pharmaceutical
industry, namely, units of activity per drug concentration (i.e. biological potency) as well as
chemical composition. CannaMetrix addresses this unmet need through proprietary human
cell-based potency testing that will establish a new high bar for the industry in Cannabis
products development and product validation.

Community trust‐building and readiness

Participant experience and retention support

Equity‐aligned strategy for diverse populations

Name: Lasers for Innovative Solutions

L4iS has developed a novel tomography technique that combines laser ablation and fluorescent imaging to rapidly develop digital models of a wide variety of materials and objects.  Laser Ablation Tomography Scans produce cross-sectional images of samples that can be manipulated to generate 3D renderings, which can be processed to determine structural parameters of interest.

With unprecedented speed and detail, LAT Scans enable scientists to create compositional and structural models of a vast variety of materials.

LAT technology can create high-resolution digital models in full color of virtually any object while also creating a 3D map of its composition.  

The LAT process uses a high peak-power laser to repeatedly vaporize a thin surface layer of the sample. The emitted light is routed through an optical system for filtering and imaging. The data is processed and reconstructed into a high-resolution model that can be viewed, manipulated, or virtually dissected. Depending on the aspects in which a client is interested, 3D processing algorithms are used to extract and quantify relevant data associated with these features. With resolution as fine as 800 nanometers at 18 million voxels per slice, Laser Ablation Tomography can provide excellent level of detail while simultaneously capturing the larger context.

Since July 2013, Lasers for Innovative Solutions LLC has developed a working prototype and demonstrated its efficacy on a wide variety of biological and inorganic materials - ranging from roots to rocks.

Our ground-breaking pre-clinical data shows that platelets maintain a proteomic equation of health in which levels of inhibitor and stimulator proteins for specific cellular functions exist in balance.  Protein imbalance in the platelet protein equation indicates the presence and/or progress of a disease.  

HL’s diagnostic device HessMapTM details the body’s proteomic equation for specific diseases.  The HessMapTM is not a single biomarker nor a multi-single biomarker assay. Instead, it is focused on identifying the evolution of disease by following the proteins that represent the dominant functions at each disease stage.

Our products deliver timely, non-invasive diagnostic certainty to physicians and bioPharma partners engaged in care and therapy creation for cancers and other difficult diseases.

- the wide range of ways endometriosis / adenomyosis afflicts patients,
- the diversity of patient responses to available therapies for these common and morbid diseases, and
- the failure of many patients to respond to any existing therapies.

MIT Professor Linda Griffith founded CGR in 2009 with the goal of bringing new frontiers of engineering to understanding the basic biology, physiology, and pathophysiology of the female reproductive tract. Griffith leads Center activities as Scientific Director working alongside Keith Isaacson, associate professor at Harvard Medical School, who serves as CGR’s Clinical Director.

CGR people work to answer questions like, “We’re giving endometriosis patients drugs, but do we really know their level of pain, and exactly what’s causing it?” and basic science questions like, “How do endometriosis / adenomyosis lesions cause inflammation?”, “How do drugs affect endometriosis lesions?” and “Could some drugs actually make endometriosis lesions worse?”

Through collaboration among engineers, biologists, and clinicians, CGR investigators dive into these questions from the level of basic science – growing lesions from patient-derived tissues – all the way to the clinic – piloting new technologies to monitor patient pain and discomfort non-invasively at home. The Center fosters liaisons with industry, and its research leverages all facets of engineering, with an emphasis on biological engineering.

Pediatric Brain Tumors are the most common form of solid tumor in children.  More than 3,400 children are diagnosed every year.  Outcomes for children with high-grade glioma are poor despite surgery, radiation and chemotherapy, which produce devastating neurotoxicities in a child’s developing brain.  There has been a complete lack of therapeutic advances in the past 15 years, and the median survival at tumor recurrence is less than 6 months.  

The G207 therapy consists of a single infusion directly into the tumor. The immunotherapy approach causes direct tumor cell death and also recruits immune system cells to aid the body’s own natural tumor defenses.  

In a Phase 1 clinical trial in 12 patients, G207 therapy saw Improved overall survival of 12.2 months versus 5.6 months for historical trials.  There was also a dramatic safety advantage with no serious adverse events observed.  Significantly, evidence of florid T-cell response in treated tumors turning immunologically “cold” tumors “hot” was also observed indicating the body's own immune system was activated against the tumors.

AF5 produces transparent, biologically bounded outputs that can be traced, interrogated, and aligned with emerging FDA and EMA expectations for mechanistic reasoning in early development.

The AF5 Architecture
Glassbox Simulation: transparent, interrogable safety computation

Biologically Bounded Outputs: mechanistic constraints, not statistical inference

Failure‐Condition Computation: identifying upstream biological contexts relevant to pre‐IND safety planning

What AF5 Enables
Illuminates mechanistic failure conditions earlier in development

Supports population‐specific safety assessment

Helps teams investigate the drivers of safety signals and develop defensible mitigation strategies

AF5 currently supports the computational safety architecture for federally registered clinical study NCT07462234, providing a calibration pathway for human‐centered mechanistic modeling.

We compute toxicity, we don’t predict.
