In the United States and other Western countries, lymphedema occurs most frequently as a complication of cancer treatment. Name: MIMIC-3D
Description:
MIMIC-3D is developing next-generation 3D tumor microenvironment models designed to more faithfully replicate the complexity of human cancer biology. Our platform recreates layered, living tumor ecosystems in the laboratory, enabling researchers to study how cancer behaves within realistic tissue environments rather than simplified cell cultures.

Current preclinical models present major limitations. Traditional 2D cultures fail to capture the structural and biological complexity of tumors, while animal models are costly, slow, and often poorly predictive of human responses. As a result, many promising therapies fail during clinical development despite encouraging early data.

MIMIC-3D addresses this gap by engineering advanced 3D tumor systems that integrate multiple tissue layers and cell types to better mimic the architecture and dynamics of real human tumors. These models allow researchers to introduce patient-derived cancer cells and study their behavior within a controlled yet physiologically relevant environment.

Our goal is to provide more predictive, scalable, and biologically meaningful platforms for drug discovery, therapeutic testing, and translational oncology research. By enabling more accurate evaluation of drug responses earlier in the development process, MIMIC-3D aims to help accelerate the discovery of effective cancer treatments while reducing reliance on animal testing.

Founded by a multidisciplinary team spanning oncology research, biotechnology, and translational science, MIMIC-3D is building tools that bridge the gap between laboratory models and real human disease.

Description:
GIVING VETERINARIANS AND PET OWNERS MORE  PRECISE RESULTS, EASY. ACCURATE. COST EFFECTIVE.
The A1C test for the diagnosis and management of diabetes mellitus is not just for humans anymore. Thousands of veterinarians across the country are pioneering it with their furry patients.  The first of its kind for felines and The first of its kind for felines and up to six times further (70 days for felines and 110 days for canines) than was previously available to show average glucose levels.  
EASY TO USE
A1CARE is a glycohemoglobin (A1C) dried blood spot diagnostic test. Simply complete the Test Request Form (TRF), collect enough blood to fill two of the discs on the form, and let it dry for a least two hours. Tear off the bottom portion of the Test Request Form to retain for your records.  Place the completed form into the provided postage-paid envelope and drop in the mail. Once your test is complete, results will be emailed to you within 24 hours. 
A BETTER ALTERNATIVE
Glucose meters and fructosamine tests have limitations. Glucose meters only measure blood glucose at that moment and can be impacted by animal stress, especially in felines. The resulting blood glucose curves are difficult and labor intensive to maintain.
Fructosamine testing can only provide an average 1-to-2-week blood glucose level, and the test is hard to run reliably from a lab setting, requiring the drawing and collection of blood in a heparinized tube that is then chilled and typically sent to a regional lab.
HOW A1C WORKS
When hemoglobin and glucose bond, a coating of sugar forms on the hemoglobin. An A1C test checks the amount of sugar bound to the hemoglobin in red blood cells. Since red blood cells have a lifespan of 70 days for felines and 110 days for canines, an A1C test will show how much glucose was in the blood for that period. This indicates how well diabetes has been controlled and whether a treatment plan needs to be altered.

In the field, IMaGeS lab works within the 3rd largest Reef zone in the world, the Florida Keys. Several projects have been conducted on the reef ecosystems in our local community, however, the main work we conduct is done at FIU's Aquarius Reef Base. Aquarius is the World's only dedicated underwater research facility, where all marine researchers can get together and perform long-duration underwater research. Aquarius is located at Conch Reef, 8.7 kilometers off the coast of Key Largo, and 19 meters below the surface of the water. The IMaGeS lab has worked with NASA in the facility on project NEEMO (NASA Extreme Environment Mission Operation) XXII, where astronauts conducted saturation dive-based underwater research on behalf of the lab. We also currently have past and present members of our lab working within the base of operations in Key Largo. In addition to Aquarius, the IMaGeS lab Graduate students travel the world to locations such as French Polynesia and the Great Barrier Reef to conduct their work

On the side of computational biology, researchers within the lab work on coding projects, protein structure imaging, high power computing (HPC) units, and digital twins on reef systems. The current direction of our computational work focuses on alpha-fold protein structure imagining.

Our wet lab work, we have a wide range of facilities and tools at our disposal. Our work focuses on the genetics, holo-biome, microbiology, cell biology, biochemistry, and coral microcosm of coral reef systems. We operate with the equipment of any fully stocked cell biology lab, along with hosting facilities specifically designed for reef-based research. This includes a rearing room for our model Exaiptasia Diaphana.

Description:
Lumicore is a startup Florida genomics laboratory that sequences the DNA of products and materials to determine, at the species level, what’s inside. Whether it’s food, supplements, honey, coffee, seafood, textiles, agricultural seed stock, or anything else derived from a living organism, if it has DNA, we can read it. The answer comes from the biology of the material, itself.

DNA is the most definitive form of species level identification that exists in nature. Every species on earth carries it, and most of the natural products you've ever purchased have contained it. However, for nearly every one of those products, the signature is never read, and fraudulent representation is commonplace in the global market.

The boutique supplement brand, the beekeeper selling at a farmer’s market, the importer who just wants to know what their supplier actually sent, the parent reading a label in a store aisle, the enterprise managing product integrity across a global supply chain: every one of them deserves a clear, science backed answer. Lumicore was founded to provide it.

We provide species level DNA authenticity verification for products and materials across every market where biological identity matters, we support research sequencing projects for academic, government, and industry partners, and we offer scientific consultation for organizations integrating genomic capability into their operations and strategy. Whether the work is a single consumer sample, a contract sequencing project, or an enterprise verification program, it receives the same scientific rigor.

What drives Lumicore’s mission is the conviction that the most powerful identification science on the planet should be available to everyone willing to ask the question. The mission succeeds when the question "how do you know what is in that?" has a clear, scientifically grounded answer that anyone can access.

Description:
We make the power of strong encryption and distributed networking accessible to everyone.

Biotechnology constantly uncovers new genetic markers hidden in the human genome, so your DNA is potentially life-saving for a future you, and your offspring. Markers for cancer, heart disease, Alzhiemer's, obesity, even violent behavior have been found, and more will be uncovered in the future. But in the wrong hands it could be used maliciously. We make it easy to encrypt and store your DNA on distributed networks, which give you and your future offspring access to your DNA with the strong privacy protections and indestructability of a decentralized blockchain.

We encrypt your raw genetic data using AES, the same encryption used by the world’s corporations, governments, and militaries to encrypt their data. Cracking AES using the fastest computers on earth would take trillions upon trillions of years. Even if the latest theoretical advances in quantum computing became a reality, AES is extremely likely to be secure from practical hacking for many many generations to come.

Name: Tendon Research Foundation Inc
Description:
The Tendon Research Foundation is a non-profit research organization created to help continue the life's work of Richard Schwarz. A pioneering biochemist and cellular biologist, Dr Schwarz dedicated his life to elucidating the cellular control of tendon growth and repair. His seminal research demonstrated that the adult tendon cell is in fact an alive and active cell that can produce new collagen and repair damaged tendons - building a strong data set in the face of decades of historical assumption that the adult tendon cell was a dormant and non-functional fibroblast.
The Tendon Research Foundation was created to provide a non-profit funding avenue to collaborate with SNZR LLC to advance the SNZRpl technology through proof-of-concept studies and into human clinical trials.
Donations to the Foundation will be used to fund critical biomedical research as well as support the necessary operational elements of the Foundation to ensure continued financial support for this vital research.
Rick's vision was that tendon rupture could be repaired more completely, more naturally, and with far fewer re-injuries than the current standard of care (all of which overlook the tendon cell itself) and the Foundation continues in the belief that there should be no "career ending injuries" due to tendon rupture - whether that be the career of a professional athlete or a skilled worker in a physically demanding profession.

VestraNova is designed to address this risk earlier in biologic development while preserving the properties that matter most: therapeutic function, structural integrity, developability, and scalability across therapeutic formats.

VestraNova is advancing toward wet-lab validation, its next major platform inflection point. The goal is simple: help create biologic therapies that are more durable, more tolerable, and more reliably beneficial for patients.

PathScience maintains a patent portfolio related to virtual staining and digital pathology imaging, including issued U.S. patents covering devices, systems, and methods for virtual staining.

Description: Metabulin is developing next generation insulin designed to solve a fundamental limitation of current therapies: intrinsic instability. Despite decades of innovation, recombinant insulin still relies on hexamer formulations to maintain stability, at the cost of delayed and less predictable action. This approach enables faster and more consistent insulin action, with the potential for improved glycemic control, simplified formulations, and greater reliability under real world conditions. By combining protein engineering with a deep understanding of insulin biology, Metabulin aims to redefine how insulin works, bringing it closer to the speed, precision, and stability of natural physiology. Molecular cell biologist Professor Sima Lev has been researching cancer biology for over twenty years. Specifically, she investigates cell signaling and membrane trafficking.

Prof. Lev’s studies have uncovered new information about membrane trafficking and cell signaling in the specific areas of human neurodegenerative diseases and human cancer. Success in discovering important information through research began back at her postdoctoral training where she isolated an enzyme which plays a key role in cell signaling. She found that this enzyme enhances the growth and progression of several human cancers.

Now Prof. Sima Lev and her team are working hard to identify possible treatments of triple negative breast cancer (TNBC) by studying the major signaling pathways that determine the course of the disease. TNBC primarily affects young women and currently has no known cure.She believes that this research will help to find new therapeutic targets that can prevent the progression of TNBC.

Prof. Sima Lev currently holds the Joyce and Ben B. Eisenberg Professorial Chair of Molecular Endocrinology and Cancer Research at the Weizmann Institute. She earned her BSc and MSc from Tel Aviv University and her PhD in Molecular Biology from the Weizmann Institute of Science prior to her postdoctoral research at New York University Medical Center and SUGEN, Inc. She has been awarded many fellowships and awards, including the Alon Fellowship by the Israel Council for Higher Education, the Bergmann Memorial Award from the U.S.-Israel Binational Science Foundation, and a Research Career Development Award from the Israel Cancer Research Fund.

Once a group has BOTH our identity and our genetic information, it is possible for them to learn many things about us and our extended family.

The internet has ushered in a golden age of information for the entire world. With this has come societal acceptance of public disclosure of information that used to be considered private.

Most Personalized Genomics services have similar weaknesses. They provide cheap tests to the consumer to subsidize the collection of genetic data for their benefit. They hope to profit from discoveries made from your genes.

Surgical training in ophthalmology is at an inflection point.
For decades, the field has relied on an apprenticeship model that—while foundational—was never designed for today’s demands of precision, scalability, or rapid innovation. Variability in case exposure, limited objective feedback, and the disconnect between training environments and real-world device development have created gaps that are increasingly difficult to ignore.
NRSS was built to address this.
The Next-Generation Retinal Surgical System (NRSS) is a platform designed not only to redefine how surgeons are trained, but also how surgical technologies are developed, tested, and translated into practice.
At its core, NRSS aims to:
• Standardize surgical training through high-fidelity, reproducible environments
• Quantify performance using objective, data-driven metrics
• Enable surgical device innovation by providing a controlled, repeatable testing ground for new instruments, visualization systems, and techniques
• Accelerate R&D cycles—moving from concept to validation faster by integrating engineers, surgeons, and scientists in the same ecosystem
Rather than separating training from innovation, NRSS connects them—creating a continuous feedback loop between skill acquisition, device design, and clinical translation.
This opens the door to a new model of surgical education and development:
one that is predictive, measurable, and iteration-driven.
And this is just the beginning.
As surgical simulation becomes more physiologically and mechanically representative, the line between training models and living systems will begin to blur—unlocking new possibilities at the intersection of surgery, biomaterials, and tissue engineering.
NRSS is not just a training platform.
It is an infrastructure for building—and testing—the future of ophthalmic surgery.
#Ophthalmology #MedTech #SurgicalInnovation #Retina #MedicalDevices

Name: CanceRx
Description:
The problem: Roughly 90% of cancer drugs that enter clinical trials never reach patients. The most common reason isn't the science, it's the funding structure. Single-trial financing is fragile. One failure ends everything.

The solution: CanceRx uses long-duration bond structures to finance diversified portfolios of oncology clinical trials. The same risk-distribution logic that makes bond markets work, applied to the most important R&D pipeline in medicine.
By spreading capital across multiple trials in parallel, we reduce the binary risk that kills promising therapies before they reach patients. Institutional investors get a new asset class with durable, uncorrelated returns. Researchers get the runway to see their science through.

Description: Over 350,000 ventral hernia repairs (VHRs) are performed each year in the United States. However, 14-26% of VHs recur within 10-12-years after VHR, and can lead to a variety of complications, including bowel obstruction and potentially fatal bowel ischemia. In a ventral hernia, the viscera extrudes from the abdominal cavity into a hernia sac due to a rupture in the abdominal wall. One of the greatest risk factors for ventral hernia recurrence is placing excess tension on an existing ventral hernia repair, for example, by coughing frequently or accumulating fat in the abdomen. This can lead to the separation of the sutured abdominal wall edges. We believe that a method of detecting this separation has the potential to greatly reduce ventral hernia recurrence. We envision a device that can be easily implanted during a ventral hernia repair, without requiring any secondary wound healing processes to occur. The device will be most effective therapeutically if it is worn regularly by the patient in their daily life, and we aim to preserve the patient’s quality of life by making the device as ergonomic, easy to use, and durable as possible. Name: NC State Bioinformatics Research Center
Description:
The BRC at NC State: Where Biology Meets Data

When the Bioinformatics Research Center (BRC) at NC State University was founded in 2000, it was built on a key insight: understanding the genomic structure of even the simplest organisms requires applying quantitative methods to massive datasets.

In the years since, those datasets have only grown — in both size and complexity. And the need for advanced quantitative skills has become even more critical.
 
The Perfect Fit:

Biology is uniquely suited for this kind of work. It’s an inherently quantitative science, increasingly driven by high-throughput technologies that generate enormous amounts of data. In today’s research landscape, no university can maintain a strong presence in biological sciences without a robust community of bioinformatics researchers — experts who bridge the gap between biology and data science.

At NC State, the BRC is the university’s answer to that need.

What Bioinformatics Means at NC State

Bioinformatics at NC State is defined broadly and deliberately. It’s a field rooted in biology and computer science, and deeply grounded in statistics. This emphasis on the intersection of these three disciplines — biology, statistics, and computing — is what sets NC State’s program apart.

Unlike many other bioinformatics programs, the BRC places a distinctive and deliberate focus on statistics. That’s no accident. Both the center and its affiliated graduate training programs grew out of NC State’s long-established strengths in statistical and quantitative genetics.

Imagine if your favorite smartphone started lagging, the battery died in twenty minutes, and the screen stayed blurry no matter how much you cleaned it. You’d probably say the phone is "glitchy" or just old. In the world of high-end farming, plants do the exact same thing. This is what HydraNova Labs is here to fix.

To understand HydraNova, you first have to understand a problem called "Biological Debt."

Most big farms don't grow plants from seeds; they grow them by taking a "cutting" (a clone) from a mother plant. If you take a cutting of a cutting, and then a cutting of that cutting—over and over for years—the plant starts to get "tired." It collects tiny viruses (like a nasty one called HpLVd) and "glitches" in its DNA. Eventually, the plants don't grow as big, they get sick easily, and they produce less. They are carrying "debt" that makes them perform poorly.

HydraNova Labs is like the "Factory Reset" button for plants.

They use something called Generation Zero (G0) technology. Instead of just cutting a branch off a plant, they go into a lab and perform "plant surgery" at a microscopic level. They find the meristem—a tiny group of cells at the very tip of a plant that grows so fast that viruses and "glitches" can’t keep up with it. It’s essentially a "clean" version of the plant’s DNA.

By taking those tiny, clean cells and growing them in a sterile lab, HydraNova creates a "Generation Zero" plant. It’s like a brand-new, fresh-out-of-the-box version of the plant with zero "lag" and no "viruses."

Description:

This unconventional research hub is a disruptive force that leads to new and improved healthcare technologies because collaborations between engineers and physicians and life and physical scientists occur daily. 

Over the last ten years, more than 2645 journal articles, 295 inventions, 225 patents, and 20 startup companies have emerged from BI. Now we are looking toward the future and planning our next ten years. 

BI is home to 39 research groups led by our award-winning faculty. Each faculty member leads a team of students, postdocs, and/or researchers to advance scientific research. Our faculty from the School of Dentistry, College of Engineering, School of Medicine, and College of Pharmacy are all located on-site at BI. Description:
CONRAD is a non-profit biomedical R&D organization with a social mission, to improve global health through the development of innovative, user-centered technologies. We exist to facilitate the rapid preclinical-to-clinical development of safe, acceptable, affordable products and biomedical interventions that help to fill unmet women's and men's health needs globally.

Our work does not begin in the laboratory or even in the scientist's mind, but with the needs of women and men everywhere who are struggling for a better life for themselves and their families. As a multifaceted organization involved in all aspects of product development, we place high priority on those needs, doing much of our work in real settings, with real people. Our broad scope, global network and focus on reproductive health enables us to help to ensure that the emerging and changing needs of women and men in under-resourced parts of the world are acted on in swift and prudent ways.

Name: TOKU-E Company
Description: TOKU-E Company specializes in the development and manufacturing of ultra-pure antibiotics and fine chemicals for life sciences research, not for human or animal use. Through cutting edge technology and human ingenuity, TOKU-E is able to facilitate the advancement of cell- micro- and plant biology. Holding true to its uncompromising standard of precision and perfection, TOKU-E has positioned itself as a global leader in biotechnology innovation with great benefits and applications for biotechnology research scientific communities.

Name: GID BIO, Inc.
Description: GID Group’s SVF-2 device and therapy, pending FDA approval, gives providers and patients a major development in cellular medicine to help treat osteoarthritis pain and to delay or provide an alternative to total knee replacement surgery. GID’s technology harvests, isolate and reimplants the right type and combination of one’s own healing cells. Our first FDA-approved pivotal clinical study, a closely watched rigorous trial, had no serious adverse events and showed significant improvements in pain and function. The FDA has granted conditional approval for a second final pivotal clinical trial. Cellular therapy addresses an unmet need in 14 million people living with osteoarthritis of the knee, offering a less time consuming, painful and costly treatment for everyone that requires no joint surgery and no drugs for osteoarthritis pain. Help relieve the $200 billion burden of osteoarthritis management on our healthcare system. Heal intelligently.

Name: MD Bioproducts
Description: A biotechnology company which provides quality life science products, such as, antibodies, reagents, and assays for inflammatory and autoimmune diseases, pain, metabolism, oncology, and neurology research.

Name: Yale Biomedical Imaging Institute
Description:
The mission of the Yale Biomedical Imaging Institute (Yale BioImaging) is to cultivate an interdisciplinary and dynamic research environment that will transform our understanding of health and disease through biomedical imaging.

Yale BioImaging encompasses world-renowned research and clinical faculty from Yale (School of Medicine, School of Engineering and Applied Science, Graduate School of Arts & Sciences) who interface and bring collective expertise from a broad range of Departments, Divisions and Centers.

Name: SAGE Labs
Description:
SAGE, a Horizon Discovery Group Company, is a world-class Contract Research Organziation (CRO) and provider of genetically engineered research models. Using proprietary platform technologies, SAGE specializes in the application of genetic engineering for specialized research applications.

As the leader in the field of Genetic Engineering technologies, we are always looking for self-starting, enthusiastic scientists and team players who know how to hit the ground running.

Name: NeuroLux
Description:
Neurolux develops innovative discovery tools that advance neuroscience and biomedical research. Our mission is to empower researchers with high-performance technologies that enable more accurate, reliable, and minimally invasive data collection in freely moving animal models.

Our portfolio includes fully implantable optogenetic systems, wireless physiological monitoring platforms, and custom research technologies designed to support a wide range of preclinical applications. From neural stimulation to continuous measurement of physiological signals, our solutions help researchers capture high-quality data while preserving natural behavior.

By combining cutting-edge engineering with scientific collaboration, Neurolux creates adaptable, user-focused technologies that accelerate discovery and support the evolving needs of academic, biotechnology, and pharmaceutical research communities.

Name: Ikonisys
Description:
Ikonisys is transforming diagnostic medicine by enabling early, accurate and non-invasive disease detection. Through a unique combination of technology and science, Ikonisys is dedicated to helping physicians and researchers realize the promise of rare cell detection to give patients the best chance of managing their disease.
Through  its  breakthrough  fluorescence  microscopy  platform,  Ikonisys continues to develop a stream of oncology tests for a variety of cancers. At the center of the platform  is  the  Ikoniscope20,  a  robotic,  high-throughput,  microscopy  system  that  provides  a true “walk away” automated solution. In addition  to  providing  high  quality  cell  images,  the platform analyzes the cells of interest, offering an interpretation of the analysis, to facilitate the  quick,  accurate  reporting  of  the  test  result. 
 In  addition  to  automating  traditional  FISH-based  tests, the  rare  cell detection  and  analysis  capabilities  of  the  platform,  that  facilitates  the  examination  of  large complex  samples  for  the  clinically  relevant  cells,  make  it  particularly  suitable  for  circulating tumor cell-based testing.

Name: Innovative Analytics Inc
Description:
Founded by experienced pharmaceutical professionals in 2003, Innovative Analytics provides statistical analysis, clinical programming, data management, data reporting and medical writing services to Drug and Device companies across the clinical development life cycle. 

Our core values are simple:  customer focus and quality first!  For our clients, this translates into a relationship in which the client can expect:
                       On-time deliverables and transparent project management
                       Innovative and cost-effective solutions
                       Honest and open issue resolution

Proven Expertise:
                      Employees average 20 years industry experience
                      5 statisticians, (3 PhD level)
                      CCDM certified lead data managers

Innovative Analytics (IA) believes in flexible servicing to meet the client needs.

IA can provide all of the necessary data management, writing and statistical services for a complete project, protocol design through study report writing. 

We can supply experienced statistical, clinical programming, data management, and medical writing representatives to work with other service providers as part of a virtual drug development team to ensure coordinated resources to fulfill your development needs in a transparent manner.

Use IA’s expertise to jump start internal growth of analytical and data handling capabilities for emerging technologies, such as bio marker identification and validation, clinical imaging, pharmacogenomics, or molecular diagnostics.

http://www.ianalytics.biz/

Name: Prevenio
Description:
Prevenio is a specialty chemical company focused on developing safe & effective food processing and packaging solutions. By providing unique, cost effective, automated solutions that can significantly enhance food safety for its clients and their customers, Prevenio is focused on "protecting brands by protecting lives" . With technology based on novel combinations of materials, Prevenio utilizes automated process controls to deliver tailored solutions for customers in the protein, produce and dairy industries.

Prevenio has focused on using data-driven approaches to formulate safe-to-use products with exceptional pathogen-fighting capability.  Prevenio has developed processing aids and washes for the food industry.  We continue to increase its offerings through innovative R&D, including efforts focused on providing new capabilities in paper and plastic packaging to further enhance its ability to protect the consumer.

Name: Zepto Life Technology
Description:
Zepto Life Technology is a medical device company and clinical laboratory building the first targeted liquid biopsy platform for infectious diseases.

We began with invasive fungal infections because they are among the most difficult infectious diseases to diagnose. Patients often undergo invasive procedures while clinicians wait days to weeks for answers, delaying targeted treatment when time matters most.

Today, our FungiFlex testing menu is available through Zepto's CLIA-certified reference laboratory, providing targeted plasma cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing that identifies clinically important fungal pathogens directly from a simple blood sample. In parallel, we are developing the Zepto MDx Platform—a fully integrated sample-to-answer molecular diagnostic system designed to bring rapid plasma cfDNA testing directly into hospital laboratories.

Our platform is powered by proprietary Giant Magnetoresistance (GMR) biosensor technology, based on the 2007 Nobel Prize-winning discovery in physics. By combining targeted molecular testing with highly sensitive, highly multiplexed magnetic detection, Zepto is advancing a new generation of deployable liquid biopsy diagnostics for infectious diseases.

Today, Zepto's FungiFlex Mold Panel has received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation, commercial testing is available through our CLIA-certified laboratory, and our platform is advancing through NIH-supported development toward FDA clearance.

Name: Phagelux AgriHealth Inc.
Description:
Phagelux AgriHealth is a global biotech company enabling sustainable agriculture. We develop and manufacture safe biological alternatives to chemicals and antibiotics. Our products control food safety pathogens, improve animal health, reduce bacterial losses in agriculture, and increase crop yields. We have more than one dozen products commercially available in the United States and markets worldwide, as well as manufacturing in the United States and China, with additional factories planned for Europe and South America. In addition to our commercial products, we have a strong pipeline of new applications. All Phagelux products are developed in-house using our proprietary bacterial control platform with bacteriophages as the primary component.

Our products use bacteriophages to control pathogenic bacteria, improving health, yield, and performance.  With more than one dozen commercially available products in multiple markets, we are a leader in the field of precision biological agriculture. We have R&D centers and manfuacturing in Salt Lake City and Nanjing.
Location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

Name: Trilogy Analytical Laboratory
Description:
Trilogy Analytical Laboratory is a food and feed safety laboratory specializing in the analysis of mycotoxins, naturally occurring toxins caused by certain molds. We offer over 20 different mycotoxin tests, including Aflatoxin, Deoxynivalenol (Vomitoxin), Fumonisin, Ochratoxin, Zearalenone, and T-2 Toxins.  Trilogy began in 1999 with a staff of 5 and has grown to a staff of 25 with over 50 years of combined knowledge in the mycotoxin field. Over the last 11 years we have expanded our testing services, provided research and certification services, and added a line of mycotoxin testing products including columns, standards, and reference materials.

Our areas of expertise include the analyses for mycotoxins, animal drug residues, mycotoxin binders, allergens, and biogenic amines. Trilogy Analytical Laboratory can provide research assistance for various projects and has extensive experience in the development and approval of analytical procedures and test kits for approval by AOAC and GIPSA (FGIS).  Many of our services are ISO 17025 accredited and we are also an ISO 9001:2008 facility.  Please see our certificate of accreditation and scope, which can be found on our website, for a full listing of accredited services or contact us for more information.

Name: EMulate Therapeutics, Inc.
Description:
Founded in 2002 and headquartered in Seattle, WA, EMulate Therapeutics is a clinical-stage therapeutic device company. EMulate Therapeutics has invented and patented a groundbreaking technology that utilizes precisely targeted, ultra-low radio frequency energy (ulRFE) to specifically regulate signaling and metabolic pathways on the molecular and genetic levels – without chemicals, radiation or drugs – delivered via a simple-to-use non-invasive device called EMulate Therapeutics Voyager.

The company’s goal is to transform disease treatment on a global scale with ulRFE. The proprietary technology has the potential to be applied to a wide range of conditions as well as veterinary medicine and non-medical applications.

EMulate Therapeutics’ initial focus is on the treatment of patients with brain cancer who are not well served by conventional standard of care therapies, which often result in poor outcomes and devastating side effects. Additional pre-clinical work is focused on exploring new applications in oncology and pain treatment.

Name: PNEUMAGEN LIMITED
Description: PNEUMAGEN LIMITED has been reorganized to create NorthLinks Bio.  You can visit our new website at www.northlinksbio.com.

Name: BioTalk Unzipped
Description:
In our mission to Unzip the Stories Behind Medical Progress, we share the latest and greatest advances in biopharmaceuticals and medical technologies in a fun, entertaining, and hopefully enlightening interview Podcast format.  We have engaging conversations with innovative leaders and have some fun along the way also getting to know their stories, career development, and their hot take on a New News story.

We are on YouTube, Apple, Spotify, and anyhwere you get your podcasts.

Name: Aspiro Therapeutics
Description:
Aspiro Therapeutics is on a mission to revolutionize treatment for obstructive lung diseases by mimicking the protective power of CC16, a natural lung protein vital for healthy breathing. We are focused on developing advanced, disease-modifying therapies that target the underlying mechanisms of conditions like asthma and COPD, going beyond symptom relief to alter the natural course of these diseases.

By harnessing the protective properties of CC16, we aim to restore lung function and prevent disease progression, offering patients safer and more effective treatment options. Through innovation and a commitment to improving respiratory care, we strive to make a lasting impact on the lives of those affected by obstructive lung diseases.

Name: HPPE LLC
Description:
HPPE produces the next generation of high performance and cost competitive biopolymer-based products.  We are one of the few biopolymer manufacturing companies that can make biopolymer products on an industrial scale while maintaining a very precise range of product performance and quality control specifications.  

HPPE’s expertise ranges from strain engineering to producing industrially viable biopolymers for end applications in pharmaceuticals, industrial flocculation, friction reduction, oil drilling, frac fluid, and completion fluid for oil and gas companies.  Along with its extensive line of products, HPPE offers product development and toll manufacturing services.  

HPPE is committed to renewable and sustainable practices, and to the development of products designed to increase performance and add value for our customers and partners.  HPPE products offer customers an alternative to a traditional chemical derivative. Visit the company’s website at www.hppeco.com.


HPPE LLC  |  6906 Dixie St  |  Columbus, GA  31907 
Phone: 706- 563-9290  |  Fax: 706-563-0719 
www.hppeco.com  |  www.engineeredbiofluid.com  |  info@hppeco.com

Name: A.D.A.M.
Description: An on-demand personalized tissue manufacturer with full scope of related services (software, equipment, certification, digital platform etc); remotely or on site (in hospital). Our proprietary technology includes 3D printing of different tissues (initially bones), made of organic materials, which can be scalably and affordably produced and used.

Name: RealGuardUSA
Description:
Washable
Your RealGuardUSA face mask can be safely washed up to 30 times, an average of once per week, and still provide maximum antiviral protection.

Reusable
While single-use masks work for less than 8 hours, ultimately ending up in landfills, streets, and oceans, RealGuardUSA face masks are reusable for up to 6 months.

Sustainable
RealGuardUSA face masks are made without the use of poisonous leaching antimicrobials like silver, and produce less than 0.5% waste.

One RealGuard Elite Mask replaces over 200 single use masks.

Name: HEALTHY AMPLIFIED
Description:
Healthy Amplified provides a population health cloud-based platform and digital technologies that advance physician and patient engagement, optimize workflows, and foster commercially successful partnerships. 

Our cloud based solutions are more than just another mobile health solution. We provide simplified reporting with full EMR integration, clinical history tracking and analytics, and assessment tools – fostering seamless collaboration between providers, patients, and physicians.

Name: Vivaldi Biosciences
Description:
Vivaldi Biosciences is developing vaccines for protection against epidemic and pandemic viral respiratory diseases using its Delta NS1 vector and innovative cell-based production technologies. 
Vivaldi’s DeltaFLU universal influenza vaccine is in Phase 2 clinical development. Its Delta-19 universal influenza/Covid-19 vaccine will enter clinical trials in 2021. 
Delta NS1 is a versatile and robust technology platform for self-adjuvanting vaccines administered by nasal spray. Delta NS1 is a replication-deficient vaccine vector based on a genetically modified, safely attenuated influenza virus strain. Delta NS1-based vaccines have the unique ability to rapidly induce interferon, generating protection against circulating viruses entering the nasal passages, and activating systemic antibody and cell-based protective immunity.

Name: Excel Scientific, Inc.
Description:
Excel Scientific is a global supplier of microplate sealing films as well as custom film, foil and laminate constructions. For nearly three decades, Excel has been reliably supplying consumables to pharmaceutical companies, biotech industries, diagnostic OEMs, clinical laboratories, life science research and academic institutions.

We specialize in the design and manufacture of highly specialized, medical-grade film, foil and laminate-based products, tailored to optimize performance in a variety of complex applications including PCR, qPCR, ELISA, cell culture, storage, point of care disposables and microfluidic components.

For more information, please visit https://excelscientific.com/

Name: Red Mesa Science & Refining
Description:
ISO 9001:2015 certified and cGMP adherent, Red Mesa Science & Refining is a science-based, industrial-scale, full range processor of hemp CBD, CBG, CBN and other minor cannabinoid raw ingredients. Operating to both Dietary Supplements and Food Regulations, we produce bulk CBD CBG and CBN Isolate, THC-Free Broad Spectrum Distillates, Crystal Resistant Distillates (CRD), Full Spectrum Distillate for product formulators, including white labelers, co-packers and contract manufacturers.

US-grown hemp biomass is extracted to separate out the most valued compounds and further refined using advanced distillation, crystallization and liquid chromatography to guarantee purity and potency with complete traceability. ISO 17025 accredited Third-Party COAs are available upon request.

Current products include: CBD isolate, CBG Isolate, CBN Isolate, CBD Broad Spectrum Distillate, Broad Spectrum Distillate Select, Full Spectrum Distillate - Compliant, CBD Crystal Resistant Distillate, CBG Crystal Resistant Distillate, CBN Crystal Resistant Distillate, CBD CBG Crystal Resistant Distillate, CBT Distillate - Botanical, CBN Distillate Botanical, CBC Distillate - Botanical and CBL Isolate - Botanical.

Name: Arome Science Inc.
Description: Arome was founded by two mass spectrometrists with the goal to democratize mass spectrometry and make it accessible to anyone, both in terms of price and the ease of getting and understanding the results. Mass spectrometry is difficult and complex, but it is also tremendously powerful and can provide amazing insight into the molecular world. Similarly, how the field of genomics underwent a revolution that made DNA sequencing easily accessible to anyone at low cost, mass spectrometry is currently undergoing similar transition. At Arome our mission is to bring the power of mass spectrometry to a wide circle of users, rather than the few selected academic institutions or large companies it is currently confined to. We help startups and established businesses to advance in their field of research & development by providing actionable insights and answers to their research questions. We provide all the necessary expertise, knowledge, platforms and protocols to drive our clients’ R&D forward and to advance their products and services. Our unique advantage is flexibility – the ability to tailor cutting-edge scientific tools to answer specific research questions rather than applying a “one fits all” approach. We have developed protocols for sample collection, data acquisition, data analysis, results visualization, and interpretation. We provide services from consulting in study designs to results interpretations in metabolomics, but also in connection with metagenomics and gene sequencing experiments

Name: RADOM Corporation
Description: Founded with the promise to serve the scientific community with advances in plasma technology and centered around creating a robust plasma to be used by analytical chemists. Radom Corporationdevelops advanced technology that is transforming plasma-based applications globally.Their leading product MICAP-OES 1000 for optical emissions for spectroscopy instruments maximizes customers’ results and positive business performance.

Name: OrthoPreserve
Description:
OrthoPreserve is a medical technology startup that is developing an artificial meniscus replacement implant to restore knee joint function. Our goal is to relieve pain and impairment, allow for a quick recovery, and reduce the risk of arthritis and knee replacements in patients with previous meniscus injuries.

Note: The meniscus implant is currently undergoing pre-clinical testing and not yet available for human trials.

Name: Signal Bioscience
Description: Signal Bioscience is developing novel oligo-based amplification chemistries that work with existing polymerase chain reaction instruments and assay designs; improving sensitivity, specificity, speed, cost, & multiplexing capabilities.

Name: Intuitive Biosciences
Description:
Intuitive Biosciences has been supporting biomedical research since 2012 by providing kits and services to monitor nonhuman primate health. In your lab our ours, our easy-to-use platform screens NHP blood samples for infectious diseases including tuberculosis and SARS-CoV-2. From routine SPF colony screening to antibody titer monitoring for vaccines, we can support your team and your research. 

We offer: a full immunoassay platform available as turnkey system or OEM including consumables, content, SilverQuant detection reagents, analysis instruments and reporting software.

Join our email list for updates, specials, and new product launches! https://goo.gl/8kNszS

Name: Provista Diagnostics
Description: Provista Diagnostics, your neighborhood early detection center based in Alpharetta, GA, is simplifying health diagnostics. Provista is creating empowering diagnostics for Women's Health helping patients and clinicians make better clinical decisions for the enhancement of health and quality of life.  Provista is investing 100% of our COVID-19 PCR testing profits in creating life-saving diagnostic solutions for a healthier today and tomorrow with Videssa Breast Cancer Detection being launched first as early as 4thQ 2022.

Name: Replicam
Description: Replicam’s Brain OPTIMATM is a paradigm-shifting hybrid AI and neural-organoid platform for generating biologically relevant, high-fidelity human data.

Name: Greffex, Inc.
Description: GreffexTM is a privately held, multi-national company, headquartered in Aurora, Colorado. Established in 1999, Greffex has developed a novel genetic platform for the development and production of vaccines. Our proprietary GREVAXTM Universal Platform delivers vaccines in a faster, more affordable and more efficient manner. Once a pathogen has been identified, Greffex’s team designs and produces a GREVAXTM vaccine in as little as 4 weeks. The state-of-the-art flexibility of the GREVAXTM Universal Platform makes it the ideal delivery vehicle for vaccines against a wide variety of infectious disease, including but not limited to Pandemic Influenza strains, Anthrax and Dengue Fever, as well as Malaria, Hepatitis C, Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV), Ebola, HPV, Plague, Tuberculosis and a host of other vaccine candidates.

Name: Oxford Biomedical Research, Inc.
Description:
Oxford Biomedical Research (OBR) develops, manufactures and markets assay kits, recombinant proteins and antibodies for biomedical research and drug discovery. The company’s primary focus is on the identification and assay of biomarkers for oxidative stress and chronic inflammation, two major risk factors for multiple diseases.  

OBR provides a large selection of drug metabolizing enzymes including all GST isoforms and recombinant P450s. The company also provides CypExpressTM, a stable dry powder containing individual unmodified, full-length human P450s expressed in a eukaryotic system. CypExpressTM offers higher yields than bacterial recombinants or liver microsomes and is ideal for metabolite profiling and scale up.

Name: Women in Biohealth | Wisconsin
Description: Women in Biohealth (WIB) is an organization developed to support and create a network for professional women in biohealth in Wisconsin. Biohealth ranges from digital health, biotech, biopharma, medical device, health research, and much more. WIB provides a platform to empower and connect Madison’s professional women. We are currently not a nonprofit organization but are utilizing BioForward, an association representing Wisconsin’s biohealth industry, as our fiscal agent and marketing entity.

Name: TAAG - United States
Description: We make advanced biological testing accessible to every laboratory and organization, revolutionizing how biological entities are detected, identified, and managed, building a future where testing is fast, automated, predictive, and universal, enabling every organization to protect health, optimize production, and unlock biotech potential.

Name: ALLOZYNE
Description: The current market requires both innovation and growth to drive the creation of new biologics.  At ALLOZYNE, we demonstrate this through both of our technology platforms as well as across our pipeline to target key disease areas.  Both of our platforms enable the incorporation of amino acid analogues at any position to create biologics that elicit improved efficacy, tolerability and pharmacology.

Name: Dystrogen Therapeutics
Description: Dystrogen Therapeutics is a clinical stage chimeric cell therapy company focusing on rare diseases. The company is currently testing DEC therapy for Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy.

Name: TEN Healthcare
Description: TEN Healthcare is a state-of-the-art, high complexity laboratory with a focus in infectious disease testing through qPCR technology. TEN Healthcare is also providing analysis of urine and saliva samples in support of prescription drug monitoring as well as clinical blood testing.

Name: Covira
Description: Covira is an early-stage biotech company, a spinout from The University of Chicago (Sept 2018). This microbiome-focused company is based on the work of Dr. John Alverdy, MD, a world authority on the molecular basis of post-surgical infections. Covira's focus is to develop drugs that work by modulating the biological activity of the gut microbiome's resident bacteria. Covira’s lead asset (CS-0003) is a platform technology that modulates bacterial virulence and restores microbial communities to prevent post-surgical infection. CS-0003 is transformative to the field and the world is taking notice...in the 4th quarter of last year Business Worldwide Magazine named Covira Among the 2021- Top 20 Most Innovative Companies to Watch.

Name: New England Cell Therapeutics, Inc.
Description: Exciting development stage stem cell therapy company focussed on improving the lives of patients with neurodegenerative diseases and significantly limited therapeutic options.

Name: Forever Labs
Description:
Founded by a group of biomedical research scientists and medical doctors in 2015, Forever Labs is your onramp to the world of regenerative medicine. As the first regenerative biotechnology platform with an ISO-certified biobank in the U.S. and two U.S. patents, we've helped members collect, store, and use their stem cells for treatments available today and therapies on the way.

Our provider network is the largest of its kind and includes top-tier, board-certified physicians in over 15 states to preserve your body’s generative capabilities at their peak. Providers are leaders in regenerative medicine and stem cell therapy, carefully selected for their expertise and commitment to patient outcomes.

We're proud graduates of Y Combinator's 2017 batch. Our team operates out of Ann Arbor (MI), Jupiter (FL), New York (NY), San Francisco (CA), and Los Angeles (CA). Join us in following the science, not the hype. By keeping our finger on the pulse of stem cell innovation and running our own clinical trials, we bring you knowledge and access to advancements in regenerative therapies as they happen.

Name: Enfanos, LLC.
Description: Enfanos is a Seattle-based company specializing in reagents for Enzyme Activity and Metabolite/Biomarker Assays. The company was established by scientists at the University of Washington with the leadership of Professor Michael Gelb.

Name: Capsigen
Description: Capsigen is a leader in the engineering of AAV capsids for use in gene therapies, opening the path to permanent cures for patients suffering from intractable illness.  Capsigen is enabling a new era of genetic medicines based on a disease-first approach.   Powered by our TRADETM and data science platforms, we engineer vectors with the highest possible potency and cell-type specificity.  Developing genetic medicines that are tailored to the unique biology involved in the disease ensures that the therapy can bring the maximum benefit to patients.  Our team is driven in its pursuit to deliver on this promise to the millions of people depending on the advancement of science to discover new cures.

Name: Ignyte Bio
Description: While biopharma research is complex, biosourcing shouldn’t be. We provide human immune cells, along with custom development and consulting services. Our scientists have decades of experience solving complex biomaterial and product development challenges for leading biopharma companies, CROs, and academic research institutions.

Name: Clinical Biosafety Services, a subsidiary of Sabai Global
Description:
Gene Therapy.  Accelerated.  

Clinical Biosafety Services provides Institutional Biosafety Committee (IBC) Review and Biosafety Consulting Services.

Our mission and expertise at Clinical Biosafety Services is to provide accelerated, compliant review of gene transfer/gene therapy clinical trials to a convened review of a site-specific Institutional Biosafety Committee (IBC). We do this by understanding the challenges in the two client relationship of serving an institution and a sponsor. Our focus is to accelerate the trial, and remove regulatory burden and uncertainty by having our highly trained experts provide friendly, knowledgeable support during the review process. We understand these therapeutics will change medicine, and our service is to bring the trial to enrollment fruition, quickly and compliantly.

Name: Ceria Therapeutics
Description:
Ceria was founded to develop products from a proprietary platform technology to treat life-threatening human diseases characterized by overactive and dysregulated immune responses.

Ceria's platform technology consists of a novel active pharmaceutical agent comprised of a regulatory microRNA (miR-146a) conjugated to cerium nanoparticles (CNPs). Like all nanoparticles, CNPs are actively endocytosed by all cells they contact, delivering the miR-146a payload to targeted cells. 

Multiple high morbidity and life-threatening conditions are characterized by dysregulated immune responses including acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS), diabetic foot ulcers (DFU) and ulcerative colitis (UC), representing a US market of $4B. Affected tissues in these conditions all demonstrate reduce miR-146a and are corrected by our candidate drug products.

Development to date has been supported by ~$7.5m of nondilutive financing and $500k investment capital. The company is seeking up to $3m in investment capital to contribute to a first-in-man clinical study of one drug product consisting of formulated CNP-miR-146a in DFU.

Name: Adarza BioSystems, Inc.
Description: The Arrayed Imaging Reflectometry (AIR) is a label-free platform technology that enables the simultaneous detection of hundreds of analytes in a single drop of fluid. Adarza delivers industry leading precision, accuracy, and robustness enabling highly multiplexed protein detection with high sensitivity and specificity. The company’s unique technology is flexible, data-rich, and easy to use, providing the only solution that spans the entire companion diagnostic life cycle from discovery to clinic, in both high-throughput core facilities as well as point of care (POC). Much like the first gene-chips enabled multiplexed genomics analysis, Adarza’s first-to-market high-multiplex and sensitivity antibody chips will fundamentally disrupt the field of proteomics research.

Name: Proteinaceous
Description: Proteinaceous innovates powerful bioinformatic platforms that allow you to rapidly find and visualize the diversity of true proteoforms in your system. Our industry-leading precision software will transform your top-down proteomics research, helping you to see the trees for the forest.

Name: Stemina Biomarker Discovery, Inc.
Description: Stemina Biomarker Discovery is a metabolomics company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of molecular biomarkers to improve drug safety and human health.  Stemina’s cell based assays arise from the strategic convergence of two cutting edge technologies: human embryonic stem (hES) cells and metabolomics.  Stemina uses mass spectrometry to analyze the small molecules secreted by hES cells, and differentiated cells such as heart and neural cells made from hES cells, in response to drugs, injury or disease.  Stemina opened its state-of-the-art facilities for hES cell culture and mass spectrometry in the UW Research Park in Madison Wisconsin on November 1, 2007.

Name: Jade Scientific, Inc.
Description:
Since 1995, Jade Scientific, Inc. has been a trusted partner to the global scientific community, delivering high-quality laboratory equipment, chemicals, and supplies to labs around the world.

What sets Jade Scientific apart is our unmatched flexibility, speed, and resourcefulness. If you need it, we have it—and if we don’t, we’ll find it and get it to you fast. Our team is dedicated to solving problems, not just filling orders.

With a catalog of over 100,000 products, we serve industrial, research, and educational labs with everything from laboratory supplies and equipment to furniture and safety essentials. We have dedicated sales representatives in every region of the United States, ensuring personalized service and support wherever you are. Our west coast warehouse, located in Phoenix, AZ, allows us to efficiently fulfill and ship orders nationwide.

Name: RNAConnect
Description: RNAConnect was founded by innovators in the RNA community for innovators in the RNA community. We think of enzymes as “biotechnology hardware,” and we believe that better enzymes provide more accurate and complete visibility into RNA which allows you to discover, develop, and innovate faster, easier and in ways not previously possible.

Name: UNeMed Corporation
Description:
UNeMed Corporation is focused on developing and fostering relationships with industry to transfer new technology and inventions from the academic laboratory to the marketplace. UNeMed has amassed a diverse portfolio of intellectual property that represents significant advances in biomedical and clinical technology. In addition to providing technology development and commercialization services for the University of Nebraska Medical Center, UNeMed also provides services for the University of Nebraska at Omaha.

At UNeMed our partnering approach is based upon customizing our services to meet your needs; we believe that each partner and partnership is unique. We create value for our industry partners by connecting them with University researchers who help develop new products or solve challenging research problems. We also link entrepreneurs and investors with researchers who have cutting-edge technologies with startup potential. We match researchers with industry partners who have the resources and commitment to commercialize their technologies. Importantly, once the connection is made, UNeMed supports the partnership to ensure results are realized.

The UNeMed team has the expertise and skill to help facilitate the production of high quality ideas, innovative products, and elegant solutions that meet our clients’ needs. Connect with us today to learn more about the benefits of partnering.

Name: Cloverleaf Bio
Description: Cloverleaf is developing a new class of RNA therapeutics to revolutionize cancer therapy.

Name: Taiga Biotechnologies
Description:
Taiga Biotechnologies, Inc. is a clinical stage biotechnology company focused on harnessing the power of the immune system to fight solid tumors and infectious disease and on improving blood stem cell transplantation.

What we do:
•	For healthy immune systems, our immunotherapy programs temporarily boost the immune system so that it functions better to fight both solid tumors and infectious disease.  
•	For compromised immune systems, our regenerative medicine program generates a new, healthy immune system.

1.	Our lead Cell-Based Immunotherapy product candidate, TBX-3400, uses a patient’s own immune cells to help fight against solid tumors and infectious disease. TBX-3400 is an autologous cell product made from peripheral blood mononuclear cells that are treated ex vivo with our fusion protein and then delivered intravenously back to the patient the following day. 

Our Cell-Based Immunotherapy technology has several advantages over current immunotherapy approaches. 

•	We do not need to expand T-cells in the laboratory to generate enough T-cells for treatment.
•	We do not limit the response to the tumor based by engineering the specificity of the T-cell.
•	We do not require genetic modification of the T-cells to enable antitumor activity.

2. 	Our Bone Marrow Engraftment Enhancer (BMEE) program is developing a first-line product, TBX-2400, to enhance the engraftment of hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells during an allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant (HSCT). 

Our BMEE goal is to increase the chance of long-term survival of a HSCT recipient by:

•	increasing the probability of a successful engraftment;
•	increasing the rate of reconstitution of mature and functional lymphocytes; and
•	managing the complications associated with HSCT.

Vivos Inc. (OTCQB: RDGL) 

Vivos Inc. has developed an Yttrium-90 based injectable brachytherapy device, for the treatment of tumors in animals (IsoPet  ) and in humans (RadioGel TM ). Brachytherapy uses highly localized radiation to destroy cancerous tumors by placing a radioactive isotope directly inside the treatment area using the company’s proprietary hydrogel technology. The injection delivers therapeutic radiation from within the tumor without the entrance skin dose and associated side effects of treatment that characterize external-beam radiation therapy. This feature allows safe delivery of higher doses needed for treating both non-resectable and radiation-resistant cancers.

In 2018 the Company obtained confirmation from the FDA Center for Veterinary Medicine that IsoPet  is classified as a medical device according to its intended use and means by which it achieves its intended purpose. The FDA also reviewed the product labeling which included canine and feline sarcomas as the initial indications for use. The FDA does not require pre-market approval for veterinary devices so no additional approval is required. Following the demonstration phase, Vivos is able to generate revenue through the sale of IsoPet  to University animal hospitals and private veterinary clinics.

IsoPet  for treating animals uses the same technology as RadioGel TM for treating humans. The Food and Drug Administration advised using different product names in order to avoid confusion and cross-use.

CosMx SMI is a flexible, spatial single-cell imaging platform that will drive deeper insights for cell atlasing, tissue phenotyping, cell-cell interactions, cellular processes, and biomarker discovery. In 2022, AtoMxTM Spatial Informatics Platform (SIP), the only cloud-based, fully-integrated informatics platform for spatial biology, was also launched.

In 2024, NanoString Technologies has been acquired by Bruker Corporation, a leading global provider of scientific instruments and solutions. This strategic acquisition marks the beginning of a promising new chapter for NanoString and our valued customer.

Name: Genus PLC
Description:
Genus is a publicly traded global company advancing animal genetics to sustainably nourish the world. 

As a global leader in animal genetics and ag-tech innovation, we’re not just shaping the future of agriculture — we’re delivering science with purpose. From gene editing and reproductive biology to next generation breeding technologies, our work directly improves animal health, food quality, and the resilience of the global food system. 

With operations spanning the globe, Genus brings together a diverse team of geneticists, veterinarians, data scientists, and commercial experts who collaborate across disciplines and borders — united by a shared mission and guided by our core values: 
 Never Stop Improving | Collaborate as One Team | Create Value for Customers | Innovate with Purpose

* PIC (Pig Improvement Company) partners with pork producers worldwide to improve herd performance, efficiency, and sustainability through continuous genetic improvement. 

At Genus, we invest in your growth — offering meaningful work, global impact, and career development within a culture that is inclusive, ethical, and forward-thinking. Whether you’re in science, strategy, or operations, your work here matters.

Name: Umoja Biopharma
Description: Umoja is developing a new approach to cancer therapy that retools a patient’s immune system in vivo, enhancing the body’s natural capacity to fight cancer. We envision a world where all patients have access to the most advanced immunotherapies and are free from the burdens of traditional cancer therapies.

Name: BioMed X
Description:
BioMed X is a leading innovation engine where disruptive ideas in biomedical research and development come to life. With our global network of research institutes and venture-creating incubators, embedded within major innovation hubs, we bridge the gap between academic research and the needs of the pharmaceutical industry.

They perform exploratory research, deliver industry-grade results, and pave the way for next-generation therapies. At BioMed X, we value curiosity, diversity, and purpose. Together, we serve as a vital catalyst for innovation in global health - for the benefit of all patients.

Name: Ventana Medical Systems
Description:
Ventana Medical Systems, Inc., a member of the Roche Group, innovates and manufactures instruments and reagents that automate tissue processing and slide staining for cancer diagnostics. VENTANA solutions are used in clinical histology and drug development research laboratories worldwide.

Together with Roche, Ventana is driving personalized healthcare through accelerated drug discovery and the development of “companion diagnostics” to identify the patients most likely to respond favorably to specific therapies.

Name: Institute for Protein Design, University of Washington

Name: TCI Group

Andson Biotech is revolutionizing mass spec workflows for biopharma and beyond.

With our cutting-edge DynaChip X1 platform, you can accelerate and simplify your mass spec workflows, develop better and faster assays to streamline drug discovery, and reduce development time and costs to push the boundaries of your research.

Name: Praxis Genomics LLC

We help scientists see what really happens in a living animal - without stress, noise, or guesswork.

140+ years of German design. Thousands of publications.

BlueSens – Smart Bioprocess Solutions

Contact us! We are well known for our excellent customer service.

Description: Elnora is an AI agent that generates and optimizes biomedical lab protocols for biotech and pharma teams. Elnora learns from both successful and failed experiments making negative data as useful as positive. This accelerates preclinical milestones, enables more experimental risk-taking, and speeds up drug discovery timelines. Every month saved can mean millions in revenue.

Description: PanTheryxTM is the leading nutrition and biotechnology company committed to the global commercialization of bovine colostrum-based health and wellness solutions. From establishing ourselves as the world’s premier supplier of colostrum, to driving cutting edge research, to commercializing novel solutions, we are dedicated to harnessing the power of nature’s superfood to develop revolutionary approaches to human and animal health.

Name: Wilson Wolf Manufacturing, LLC
Description:
Wilson Wolf Manufacturing invents, designs, and manufactures innovative cell culture devices and associated ancillary products. Our mission is to create hope for cancer patients, one device at a time. 

G-Rex bioreactors, our flagship product line, are uniquely suited for the rapid expansion of immune cell types for academic research and commercial cell therapy manufacturing. We focus on the revolutionary field of T cell therapy, which is generating impressive clinical outcomes for once incurable cancer types.
 
Wilson Wolf has partnered with Fresenius Kabi and Bio-Techne to form ScaleReady, a marketing, technical support, and commercialization organization focused on providing the most scalable cell therapy manufacturing platform in the industry. The spirit of the partnership and the ScaleReady business allows us to simplify T cell manufacturing by offering the most innovative solutions in the industry, both immediately and into the future, through collaborative development of new products that address the challenges of scaling a cell therapy.

Contact us with questions or to learn how our expertise in the field of T cell therapy manufacturing can help your organization develop commercially viable, highly reliable and repeatable manufacturing processes.

Name: Starfish Neuroscience
Description:
We are a neuroscience company developing a broad range of foundational technologies to enable new ways to interact with the brain.

Behind all the science and research is simply our drive to improve people’s lives. We are determined to deliver meaningful, positive impact through advancements in our work.

Name: Celsee, Inc.
Description: Celsee, Inc., is harnessing the gentle power of gravity to break down barriers in single-cell analysis. Our technology’s unparalleled capture and viability rates, plus the ability to scale easily to millions of cells, deliver high-confidence results for applications such as single-cell cytometry, proteogenomics, transcriptomics, and rare-cell enumeration. With Celsee’s Genesis system, users can achieve accurate biological insight by capturing more cells, because every cell matters. Celsee is a privately held company based in Ann Arbor, Michigan.

Name: PolarityBio
Description: PolarityTE, Inc., headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah, is a biotechnology company developing regenerative tissue products.  PolarityTE's first regenerative tissue product is SkinTE.  PolarityTE has an open investigational new drug application (IND) for SkinTE with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and is now pursuing the first of two pivotal studies on SkinTE needed to support a biologics license application (BLA) for a chronic cutaneous ulcer indication.  SkinTE is available for investigational use only. Learn more at www.PolarityTE.com.
Location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

Name: Clinical Research Advancement
Description:
Clinical Research Advancement (CRA) is a leading global Contract Research Organization (CRO) and a trusted partner to biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies worldwide.
27+ years of expertise. 80+ clients. 200+ complex clinical studies. Global footprint spanning North America • APAC • Africa • UAE.
Our integrated capabilities:
