Advancing Clinical Research to Enhance Outcomes.

Name: Archon Biosciences
Description:
Archon is a biotechnology company developing computationally designed proteins to unlock powerful therapeutic targets that lie beyond the reach of existing modalities and to better treat disease.  

We directly apply generative protein design to create a new biologic class, Antibody Cages (AbCs), that integrates the industry-proven affinity and specificity of antibodies into self-assembling nanostructures. Precise control over AbC structure provides the ability to tune both how they distribute in the body and engage their cellular targets with high specificity and potency to establish a new gold-standard for biologic medicines.  

Archon Biosciences is based in Seattle and supported by a team of forward-thinking investors led by Madrona Ventures. Our AbC platform was invented with the science and technology recognized by the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry at the Baker Lab in the Institute for Protein Design (IPD). 

If you are interested in partnering or see yourself as part of our mission, please contact us at contact@archon.bio.

Name: SCD Probiotics, LLC
Description:
At SCD Probiotics, we’re in business to replace the toxic chemicals that power our lives, homes, and businesses and help undo their damage as well. We pair probiotics + postbiotics to restore health and balance to our soil, food, bodies, homes, industries, and planet. 

When SCD Probiotics founder Matt Wood was just beginning his adult life, his mother was diagnosed with advanced leukemia. After her death, Matt left college to care for his grandparents—who both also had cancer—starting him down a path of research that would change the direction of his life.  

He made his return to school with a new purpose. As he dug into studying chemicals and their negative impact on soil, food, and human health, he was awakened to probiotics and the essential ways they empower health—a role that has been damaged by modern technologies. Under the tutelage of pioneers of the field, he discovered that when you restore balance to the microbial world, you restore the health of the ecosystem they support.  

Matt knew then that as a scientist, he had a responsibility to bring the power of probiotics to the world. Over 20 years of research and development, we’ve built a biotech platform to create safe, sustainable, and effective probiotic products for agriculture, industrial use, and consumers. Through multiple decades of international outreach, we’ve created a global licensee and distributor network—exporting our technology and products to six continents to impact health and sustainability worldwide.

The products that power our lives shouldn’t deteriorate or endanger our health, or the health of the planet we call home. We want to be part of that change. 

Excited? Visit scdprobiotics.com to join our probiotic revolution.

Name: Plastomics, Inc.
Description:
Plastomics'  novel trait delivery technology harnesses the power of the plant cell to create crops than can better withstand the pressure of insects, diseases and weeds and that are more efficient and deliver higher yields.

Plastomics technology will give seed companies the benefits of simplified product development, more effective products and new market opportunities.

Name: Leash Bio
Description: Every single machine learning (ML)-driven breakthrough, from language translation to Go championships, was immediately preceded not by an algorithmic innovation but by a massive, well-controlled, purpose-built dataset. An ML-driven breakthrough in medicinal chemistry is going to require a similar dataset, but such high-quality, well-structured experimental data doesn’t exist yet. We're building that data set by making physical measurements of lots of targets (with automated in-house protein production) screened against lots of compounds (with DNA-encoded chemical libraries). We're also building the ML models, that will eventually be generalizable across any protein and novel medicines using insights from our models.
Location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

Name: EdgeOne Medical
Description:
EdgeOne Medical provides critical product development support, in-house testing, and life cycle management of medical devices and is the trusted partner for more than half  of the top 20 global biopharmaceutical companies. 

EdgeOne Medical is a Contract Development Organization (CDO) supporting Class I , II  and III medical devices and combination products from concept to end of life.

EdgeOne Medical partners with small, medium and large medical device, Biotech, and Pharma companies and is governed by ISO 13485 quality system and 21 CFR Part 820.

Name: G-Biosciences
Description:
G-Biosciences is an ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 13485:2016 certified, cGMP, FDA.QSR (21 CFR 820) compliant life sciences laboratory and manufacturing facility with experience in academic and industrial research and custom manufacturing. Our high-quality reagents are cited in over 27,000 publications, a number that continues to grow. Our goal is to provide simple-to-complex research tools, assays and testing kits, reagents, buffers, and specialty chemicals. 

Our extensive research, development, and manufacturing knowledge has allowed us to develop products for multiple research areas, including proteomics, nucleic acids, PCR, qPCR, Immuno-technology, bioassays, cell biology, histology, cytology, and cell health assays. This makes G-Biosciences a one-stop location for research supplies, tools, and full-service custom manufacturing needs. In addition, we have developed over 70 hands-on teaching kits for teachers and our future researchers.


We offer expert, top-quality customs and OEM manufacturing that meets the biotech industry's strict quality management systems and cGMP requirements. We offer private label services around our full range of reagent manufacturing capabilities, performed by highly trained professionals, including research and development, custom manufacturing, purification resin synthesis, and production.

Name: Verdant Technologies
Description: At Verdant Technologies, we’re experts in the science of freshness. From farm to table, we’re changing the benchmark for freshness and sustainability. Our innovative products are the perfect marriage of science and nature, resulting in endless opportunities for growth in the produce and floral categories.

Name: Aquila Solutions, LLC
Description:
Aquila is a Regulatory Publishing Services Company specializing in the publishing needs of Pharmaceuticals and Biologics companies.  Our goal is ‘First Pass’ approval of your application while assisting you to develop your long term lifecycle management needs.  Most submissions are completed within 24 hours.  Contact us for the fastest service available!
 
We provide every service necessary to successfully submit your application including eCTD (INDs, (A)NDAs, BLAs, MAAs CTAs and others), SPL, ClinicalTrials.gov submission, SAS Data Package review and other services you may need to publish your application and win approval.
 
Aquila also believes in supporting our clients past the current sequence or application.  We support our clients through the full lifecycle of their products and assist as needed to support their publishing needs at the lowest cost possible.  This often includes assisting our clients develop their internal RegOps systems.  We help clients internalize systems where appropriate, outsource where necessary and always provide the most cost effective solution for your unique situation.
 
Sincerely,
 
Josh Boutwell, MBA RAC
CEO and Founder

Name: Endevica Bio
Description: Endevica Bio is a world-leader in the discovery of first-in-class peptide drug candidates. Endevica Bio's proprietary technology platform, protected by a robust intellectual property portfolio, allows for the AI-assisted design of novel peptides to modulate activity of previously undrugged G-protein coupled receptors behind the blood-brain barrier, bringing new hope to areas of high unmet medical need.

Name: adyn
Description:
Founded by Dr. Elizabeth Ruzzo, adyn is helping people find birth control without side effects based on a person's genetic risk and hormone profile. Despite the 47M birth control users in the US, virtually no studies examine the biological factors that explain why individuals respond differently to a given contraceptive method.

Launched in May 2022, The Birth Control Test is the first test designed to prevent birth control side effects. While we are improving the birth control experience, we are also committed to closing the gender health gap. By partnering with individuals, adyn leverages personal preference, medical history, and biological data to proactively help every (unique) body select the most desirable birth control option – with the least dangerous side effects.

Our vision is to be earth’s most inclusive and patient-centric personalized medicine company. When a person uses The Birth Control Test, they can opt in as an anonymous research participant to help close these research gaps. This means you can simultaneously find the right birth control for your body, while helping others do the same.

Name: Veloxity Labs, LLC
Description:
Veloxity Labs is a bioanalytical CRO built for programs that need speed with substance. We deliver non-regulated, GLP and GCP-aligned LC–MS/MS bioanalysis across discovery, preclinical and clinical phases—producing high-quality data aligned to ICH M10. 

Our scientists support a wide range of modalities—small molecules, peptides (including GLP-1 receptor agonists), proteins and ADCs—with phase-appropriate methods that move fit-for-purpose to GLP without rework. We’re also experts in microsampling and patient-centric sampling devices. 

Sponsors—from emerging biotechs to global pharma—rely on Veloxity for fast project starts, rapid turnaround and clear communication, supported by robust QA and documentation. We also serve animal health programs with the same rigor. 

We help teams accelerate the development of life-changing therapeutics—treating disease one sample at a time while moving at the speed of bioanalysis! 

Learn more at veloxitylabs.com.

Name: Foundation for Biomedical Research
Description: Established in 1981, the Foundation for Biomedical Research (FBR) is the nation’s oldest and largest organization dedicated to improving human and veterinary health by promoting public understanding and support for humane and responsible animal research. FBR is the leading voice of scientific reason and medical progress in the ongoing debate that surrounds animal research.

Name: Liquidyne Process Technologies, Inc
Description:
Liquidyne is a high-purity, fluid handling and measurement company dedicated to helping growing companies keep their fluid transfer process clean, modern, efficient and running smoothly. 

Founded in 1993, Liquidyne serves the food, beverage, biotech, pharmaceutical, chemical and industrial industries. We specialize in providing everything from high-quality single-use components, including tubing, connectors, valves and pumps — to full service design of complex, high-purity systems. 

Throughout our 30+ year history, we’ve found that it’s not enough to sell great fluid handling products. Our customers also need to make informed purchasing decisions and rely on us as a trusted and knowledgeable resource. That’s why Liquidyne was founded on the premise of providing only the highest quality, certified products and generously sharing technical expertise since the very beginning.

Whether you need to optimize your process flow, improve purity standards, find hard-to-get products, or plan a modern, efficient design to grow your operations, our liquid handling experts are available to guide you. Each member of our team is informed and invested in your business. We’ll help you learn about the latest fluid handling innovations, compare product specifications and understand best practices.

Need sanitary tubing? Our in-house clean room can quickly provide sanitary tube assembly on site. Hose leaking or need a custom build? We either have the exact size you need, or our in-house hose fabrication facility can turn a custom hose in a day. Liquidyne’s investment in in-house hose fabrication and clean room facilities, guarantee a faster turn-around time.

Quality. Integrity. Expertise. Responsiveness. — that’s liquid handling the Liquidyne way.

Name: NorayBio. Software for Biosciences
Description:
NorayBio is a bioinformatics company that offers support to the biosciences sector, biotechnology, biomedicine and biopharmacy, through the development of new bioinformatic solutions.

In NorayBio we create computing programs, application software that facilitates work in the biotechnology sector.

Our objective is to help researchers handling the vast amount of information generated in scientific and biotecnological research, facilitanting the biological comprehension of the obtained data.

Name: Known Medicine
Description: Known Medicine is looking to take the experimentation of how tumors respond to cancer drugs out of the patients body and into the lab. The startup breaks down tumor samples into micro tumors, which they treat separately inside specialized micro-environments with different methods and see what works best.
Location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

Name: Neuromics
Description:
We specialize in providing reagents and methods for the Neuroscience Research Community. As a natural extension, we are growing our catalog to serve Diabetes-Obesity, Immune Response, Apoptosis Detection, and Cancer Researchers. Our offerings include products for optimizing cell-based assays for basic research and drug discovery. These include primary cells, iPSC-derived cells, cells lines, 3D models and more. In addition to human cells, we also offer primary antibodies, specialized media, FBS & other sera, recombinant proteins, and more.

Neuromics is also a US distributor for IBA Lifesciences. We offer their entire portfolio of cutting-edge protein purification products.

Our unique value is based on providing reagents that are thoroughly tested and characterized. Our reagents need to work in your unique application.

Name: Center for Advanced Bioenergy and Bioproducts Innovation (CABBI)
Description:
CABBI is one of four Bioenergy Research Centers established by the U.S. Department of Energy to break down barriers to a domestic bioenergy industry.

CABBI is providing the scientific discoveries and new technologies to develop an economically viable and ecologically sustainable biofuel and bioproducts industry from dedicated bioenergy crops.

Our researchers integrate recent advances in agronomics, genomics, and synthetic and computational biology to increase the value of energy crops — using a “plants as factories” approach to grow fuels and chemicals in plant stems, employing an automated foundry to convert biomass into valuable chemicals, and ensuring that those products are ecologically and economically sustainable. This holistic approach will help reduce our nation’s dependence on fossil fuels.

Name: Cell Guidance Systems
Description:
Cell Guidance Systems develops specialist reagents and services for life science research, with particular expertise in extracellular vesicle biology, sustained-release growth factor delivery and cytogenetics.
Our EV portfolio includes Exo-spin SEC isolation kits, EVlution TFF systems, ExoLISA biomarker assays and a full outsourced EV isolation and MISEV-compliant characterisation service including NTA, western blot and freeze drying.
PODS sustained-release growth factors and cytokines enable prolonged, localised protein delivery in vitro and in vivo — cited in peer-reviewed research across neuroscience, oncology and regenerative medicine.
Our cytogenetics service provides professional karyotype analysis and AGH testing for academic and commercial laboratories.
Based at Babraham Bioscience Campus, Cambridge UK, with offices in St. Louis, USA.
To discuss your research requirements or request a quote: cellgs.com/evexosome-service-enquiry

Name: Aminolab Ltd.
Description:
Aminolab provides a wide range of analytical laboratory services in the areas of Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Medical Devices, Medical Cannabis, Environmental care, Pesticides residues, Food and Cosmetics and all under one roof. 

With  30 years of experience, Aminolab is housed in modern state-of-the-art facilities in the Weizmann Science Park in Ness Ziona and staffed by highly qualified and experienced professionals.

Our laboratories adhere to ISO/IEC 17025, and are recognized by the Ministries of Health, Agriculture, Labor and Environment. 

Aminolab Laboratories are GLP certified according to the European Union Directive 88/320/EEC by the Israeli Accreditation Authority (ISRAC) in the areas of Analytical Chemistry and Tests for Microbial contamination for the Pharmaceutical and Biotechnolgy industries. Furthermore, Aminolab had an outstanding success in FDA audits. Recently Aminolab has been approved by the Ministry of Health as a GMP Laboratory to provide services in the Microbiology area for the Pharmaceutical Industry. 

Aminolab was founded in 1988 as a private laboratory, specializing in amino acid analysis, and has since gained market recognition for its uncompromising quality services and reliability  by hundreds of customers in Israel and abroad.

Name: Astrobiology.com
Description: Online guide to life in the universe

Name: Virscio

We specialize in the fields of central nervous system, ophthalmology, cardiovascular, metabolic and dermatologic diseases, and have advanced preclinical toxicology and efficacy programs for sponsors around the world.  We work with pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, and consultants and academic teams to reduce development risk and define the most effective path to value inflection and clinic.

Name: Capra Biosciences
Description: Capra Biosciences is developing a new technology that will make the manufacturing of chemicals using biology cost-competitive with petroleum-based products. Significant advances in synthetic biology have been made over the past 20 years, enabling a multitude of products with lower environmental impact and potentially better performance than their petrochemical counterparts. However, cost-competitive large-scale manufacturing of these products remains a significant bottleneck to their adaptation.  Our technology tackles this bottleneck through an innovative bioreactor design that promises to significantly reduce end-to-end manufacturing costs.

The algorithm is specifically optimized for unrivaled accuracy for both previously negative biopsy and biopsy naïve patients.

Description: Logos Biosystems is the life science solutions of Aligned Genetics, Inc., dedicated to the development and commercialization of innovative technologies to support the life science research community. Since its founding in 2008, Logos Biosystems has been developing a series of automated systems and imaging instruments for laboratories engaging in research with a cellular and molecular emphasis.

Description: 3i designs and manufactures technologies for living cell, live cell, and intravital fluorescence microscopy including digital holography, spinning disk confocal, multi-photon and lightsheet. Our experienced team of scientists and engineers continue a 20+ year tradition of creating advanced research instrument systems that can be expanded with an array of technologies to address both established and emergent scientific methods.

Name: Agragene Inc
Description:
Agragene, Inc. is a Bio-AgTech company based in St. Louis, MO focused on creating innovative pest control solutions for growers. Agragene plans a limited launch of its inaugural product, KNOCKOUTTM SWD, in 2027 to combat more than $5B in annual berry and cherry damage caused by the invasive Spotted Wing Drosophila.

Follow our page for the latest updates on how we’re transforming agriculture through modern biotechnology solutions.

Name: Solinatra
Description:
Solinatra is the truly sustainable solution to single use plastics. 

Innovative biomaterials that are 100% natural and plant based, with all the benefits of plastic and none of the drawbacks. Fully biodegradable and compostable in all situations, Solinatra doesn’t leave behind any microplastics. Blends of Solinatra are available to suit a wide range of applications, with food and non-food contact approved materials suitable for manufacturing in existing production lines.

Name: AVM Biotechnology
Description:
The company's lead drug AVM0703, a proprietary innovative formulation of dexamethasone, when given at supra-pharmacologic doses has a novel mechanism of action to mobilize the body's own natural supercharged immune cells. AVM0703 triggers the production and release of endogenous gamma delta TCR+ invariant TCR+ bispecific T lymphocytes and Natural Killer T cells and could be the first choice for no-option cancer, autoimmunity, and infectious disease. 

AVM Biotechnology was founded by Dr. Theresa Deisher with a personal mission to defeat cancer and has a Scientific Advisory Board including well-respected leaders in cancer and immunology. The company is committed to developing products that improve outcomes without additional suffering because side effects from treatments should never be worse than the diseases themselves.

Name: Illinois BIOE
Description: The department of bioengineering at the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign develops innovative engineering, technology, and quantitative methods to address grand challenges in human health and sustainability.

Name: Nanosphere
Description:
Nanosphere is dedicated to enhancing medicine by providing targeted molecular diagnostic tests that can lead to earlier disease detection, optimal patient treatment and improved healthcare economics.

Nanosphere’s platform, the Verigene System, enables clinicians to rapidly identify and treat the bacteria and viruses responsible for some of the most complex, costly and deadly infectious diseases. 

Headquartered in Northbrook, Illinois, Nanosphere was founded in 1999 based upon technology developed at Northwestern University by Dr. Robert Letsinger and Dr. Chad Mirkin. In 2007, Nanosphere went public (NASDAQ: NSPH), and has remained committed to continued scientific discovery and innovation with more than 175 patents to its name. 

Currently, our test menu targets infections of the bloodstream, respiratory tract and gastrointestinal tract.

Nanosphere is now a Luminex company.

Name: Fitzsimons Innovation Community
Description:
Fitzsimons Innovation Community is a connected campus of leading-edge laboratory workspace where innovative health and life sciences companies of all sizes take their research to the next level to cure diseases, save lives, and improve care. 

Our customized workspace, collaborative campus, and proximity to the University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus make our community the perfect place to put down roots and get to work.

Name: Likarda, Inc.
Description:
Likarda is a biotech company developing enabling technologies to transform the way cell therapies are delivered and optimized. Our revolutionary method to coat cells with stealth hydrogels, called Core Shell Spherification (CSS), protects cells from destruction, keeping them viable while maintaining them in the intended location within the body.

Unlike our competitors, Likarda has developed a library of over 50 different hydrogel formulations that work with Core Shell Spherification, resulting in the ability to uniquely tailor the coating molecules to the specific requirements of the therapeutic cells themselves. From durable and long-term coatings to degradable coatings that deliver cells over days, weeks, or months, we can create exclusive hydrogel formulations tailored for each therapeutic application.

Likarda is the remarkable culmination of visionary leadership, science that is just as artistic as academic, and a compelling urge to do what’s right. As we move forward, we have well-defined, long-range goals with added opportunities for flexibility and growth.

Name: Jeneil Biotech, Inc.
Description:
Jeneil Biotech, Inc. is a family-owned biotechnology and natural flavor innovation company headquartered in Saukville, Wisconsin, with a European hub in Schechen, Germany. We specialize in fermentation, enzyme biotechnology, and precision bioprocessing, creating clean-label, sustainable ingredients for the food, beverage, health, and industrial sectors.

Founded in 1995 by Dr. N. R. Gandhi and Josephine Gandhi, Jeneil remains family-managed and mission-driven. Even our name reflects that heritage — inspired by their children, Jennifer and Neil.

With decades of scientific excellence, flavor expertise, and commercial fermentation scale, we develop and supply:
• Natural dairy flavors – butter, cream, cultured, and enzyme-modified cheese (EMC) systems
• Savory and dairy-type flavors for plant-based foods and alt-dairy applications
• EU-natural flavor and fragrance molecules via sustainable biotechnology
• Probiotic cultures and microbiological solutions supporting human and animal health
• Natural biosurfactants (rhamnolipids) for personal care, home care, and agricultural innovation

Our full-service capabilities span bench-top R&D through pilot and commercial fermentation, supported by SQF-certified facilities with Kosher, Halal, and Organic certification options.

We collaborate with leading food brands, ingredient houses, and industrial partners to co-develop tailored solutions that balance taste, performance, label transparency, and sustainability.

Mission: To transform nature’s microbiological processes into high-performance, clean-label ingredients that delight consumers and advance sustainable innovation.

Vision: To be the global benchmark in fermentation-based ingredient technologies, pioneering scalable biological solutions for a healthier, more flavorful world.

Name: trialport
Description:
trialport is a clinical trial navigation and decision-support platform. We help people find clinical trials, understand them in plain language, and decide with confidence whether a study fits their health and their life.

People search for clinical trials every day. Far fewer understand what they find. A person can locate a study and still not know what participation involves, whether they are likely to be eligible, whether it fits their daily life, or whether they feel ready for the next step. The issue is not just access. It is comprehension at the moment of choice.

trialport is an AI native clarity layer for clinical trials, built to improve decision quality before formal screening begins. For every study we provide:

• A plain-language summary with medifitTM + readifitTM self-reflection tools
• medifit: Is this trial right for my health?
• readifit: Is this trial right for my life?
• Neutral decision support grounded in behavioral science and shared decision making
• Support for clinical trial readiness and better-prepared next steps

trialport does not recruit participants. We support the patient recruitment and enrollment activities of sponsors, CROs, and clinical trial sites by improving understanding upstream: better-prepared referrals, stronger patient engagement, reduced screening friction, and clearer signal on fit and readiness.

The trialport Live Network is our embedded distribution and engagement layer. It reaches people through trusted environments, from grassroots to global charity and patient advocacy groups, pathology labs, pharmacy networks, early access providers, patient research panels, point-of-care access, and trusted media partners.

Our experienced team brings a proven track record across AI, engineering, product development, clinical operations, patient engagement, clinical trial site management, and Phase I to III studies, from both biopharma and commercial trial-unit perspectives.

Understanding comes first. Decisions follow.

Name: TechMix
Description:
Water is the primary transport vehicle for nutrients like vitamins, minerals and energy into cells and also for removing waste products and toxins from the body. At the cellular level, hydration health is more than just water consumption and can include critical nutrients transported through water that support physiologic recovery and overall health. Our nutrient-rich hydration products provide animal caretakers with proven, effective hydration solutions that optimize the health and wellness of animals. 

In 1983, TechMix introduced BlueLite, which is the technological gold standard for hydration support in the livestock industry. Often recognized as “Gatorade for animals”, BlueLite offers animals the optimal hydration and nutrient support required to maximize their well-being and potential. Click to learn more. 

Maintaining adequate hydration status is important at all times, and especially during times of stress when livestock feed and water intake is compromised. Explorations and innovations of diverse technologies are how TechMix promotes animal sustainability by redefining hydration to keep animals drinking, eating and producing.

Name: VitriVax
Description:
VitriVax is redefining how vaccines and therapeutics are delivered.
Our ALTA platform enables thermostable, single-shot formulations - removing cold-chain barriers and unlocking global access.

Name: SNBL
Description:
The mission of SNBL Group is to free patients from suffering by supporting drug development and improving medical technology.

The nonclinical research division of SNBL is Japan’s largest and oldest nonclinical CRO. 
For over 65 years, we have balanced speed with superior quality, carrying out studies efficiently, accurately and in a timely manner, consistently exceeding our customers’ expectations; because this is not just a job, it’s our passion.
At SNBL, we embrace the challenges of innovation, growth and development in order to provide a meaningful contribution to the well-being of all people.

Contact us at info@snbl.co.jp today to learn more about our capabilities.

Name: Stratos Genomics
Description:
ULTRA-LOW-COST GENOME SEQUENCING 
Stratos Genomics' goal is to establish the next gold standard of DNA sequencing with its “Sequencing by ExpansionTM” (SBX) method. SBX is a simple, elegant, single-molecule detection process that circumvents the limitations of competing technologies, allowing accurate, ultra-low-cost whole-genome sequencing.

With this advancement, SBX single-molecule sequencing technology will have a similar disruptive impact on the NGS market as PCR did for molecular diagnostics.

SBX empowers you to do more, from targeted oncology panels and whole-genome sequencing to rapidly diagnosing infectious diseases.

Name: Emory Technology Transfer
Description:
"My hope is that this technology will make millions of people better and not harm a single one.” – Charles M. Epstein, MD, neurologist, founder/director of the Laboratory for Magnetic Stimulation at Emory University, and co-inventor of NeuroStar TMS Therapy

Emory’s Office of Technology Transfer works to make this kind of hope a reality. With success stories like the commercialization of the 3TC/FTC HIV drugs, the Emory Cardiac Toolbox, and Axumin, we have a track record of results.

The technology transfer process is one of innovation and collaboration. We work with Emory University inventors to license and market their technologies. We also partner with industry members in hopes of developing those technologies and bringing them to the marketplace. We facilitate the movement of exciting technologies out of the lab and into the hands of those who need them.

Let’s partner. Together, we can maximize the benefits of innovation in service of humanity. Learn more at http://www.ott.emory.edu.

Name: Quetzal Therapeutics
Description:
Through cutting-edge science and pioneering innovation, we develop breakthrough therapies that improve patients’ lives. Our mission is to push the boundaries of treatment possibilities, delivering hope and life-changing solutions to those who need them most.

Quetzal Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the development of treatment for rare diseases including hematologic malignancies. Our lead investigational therapy, QTX-2101, offers a novel treatment paradigm for Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia (APL). With strong momentum behind us, we are now entering Phase III clinical trials. Quetzal is also developing a pre-clinical asset QTX-2102, an advanced, next-generation antifungal and antiparasitic therapy designed to enhance efficacy while minimizing toxicity.

Name: Tek-Matic
Description: For over thirty years, Tek-Matic has been providing engineered robotic and dispensing automation solutions to a wide variety of high tech industries, including biomedicine, defense, food production, environmental sciences, and laboratory R&D. With "Automation for Life" as its mission, Tek-Matic is committed to helping the world discover and produce better ways to heal, feed, protect, and preserve.

Name: Precision X-Ray, Inc.
Description:
Headquartered in Madison, Connecticut, Precision is the largest global manufacturer of cabinet x-ray irradiation systems providing safe, reliable, and reproducible results. Since the turn of the century, we continue to provide thousands of partners around the world with products that lead technological innovation in commercial, agricultural, and academic irradiation treatment fields.

Serving World Class Institutions
Precision X-Ray leads technological change in preclinical radiation research by listening to the needs of its customers. Advances in the understanding of the molecular biology of cancer, combined with rapid technological advances in radiation therapy targeting and delivery are emphasizing the need for greater capacity to study radiation effects in complex systems.  We stay abreast of these advances and develops new applications and new equipment to meet expanding customer application needs.

Superior Customer Service
In addition to offering a full line of X-ray irradiation systems and options for applications including pharmaceutical, scientific, preclinical research, and agriculture, we are committed to customer service. We offer field and in-house service and telephone support as well as preventative maintenance contracts to ensure that customers’ equipment is calibrated and operating at peak performance.

Name: BD-GenCell Biosystems
Description:
GenCell Biosystems is a developer of innovative biological testing instruments based in Limerick, Ireland.  Founded in 2011, currently employs over 60 people. GenCell Biosystems was acquired by BD (Becton, Dickinson and Company) on Oct 13, 2014

BD-GenCell Biosystems provides biology with robust, high performance systems to perform analysis faster and at lower cost than is currently possible. 

BD-GenCell’s platform Composite Liquid Cell technology mirrors nature by performing tests within inert synthetic cells. These Composite Liquid Cells are an ideal environment to perform biological chemistry. 

Commercial instrument configurations include:
•	Library preparation for next generation sequencing
•	High throughput genotyping
•	High throughput DNA extraction
•	Live cell screening for compound testing

To-date we have partnered with a number of established biotech companies to develop instrumentation for multiple applications.  The company also collaborates with various worldwide universities to continuously develop innovative technologies.

Name: iFAB Tech Hub
Description:
The Illinois Fermentation and Agriculture Biomanufacturing Tech Hub (iFAB) is poised to become the global leader in precision fermentation and biomanufacturing — an industry expected to grow to $200 billion over the next 15 years. 

Leveraging biology as a manufacturing technology of the future, iFAB is uniquely uniting world-class R&D, industry leaders, innovative startups, scalable infrastructure, abundant feedstock production, unparalleled transportation networks, and strong relationships with corn and soybean suppliers within a 51-mile radius. 

This unique lab-to-line approach establishes the iFAB region (Champaign, Piatt, and Macon counties) as the preeminent destination for the biomanufacturing industry.

iFAB leadership includes representatives from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Champaign County Economic Development Corporation, Economic Development Corporation of Decatur-Macon County, and University of Illinois Research Park.

Name: InDevR, Inc.
Description: InDevR is a leader in innovative analytical technologies for vaccine and therapeutic testing. We are committed to enhancing the speed and accuracy of vaccine and therapeutic analytical characterization via multiplexing, standardization, and automated analysis; our products and services are trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and research institutions around the globe.

Name: PTM BIO
Description:
Since its inception in 2010, PTM BIO has consistently been at the forefront of innovation in the realms of biological reagents and proteomics. Our commitment to pioneering technologies is driving advancements in the study of protein post-translational modification (PTM) and epigenetics, effectively meeting the critical needs in these specialized fields.

Our integrated platform combines exclusive PTM reagents, IVD raw materials, advanced mass spectrometry proficiency, and state-of-the-art bioinformatics tools to redefine the landscape of biomedical and pharmaceutical research. PTM BIO is devoted to developing and offering groundbreaking research products and services, revolutionizing the way we comprehend, diagnose, and combat human diseases. 

Explore more about PTM BIO at www.ptmbio.com.

Name: Gates Institute at CU Anschutz
Description: Gates Institute strives to transform patient care by advancing breakthrough regenerative, cell and gene therapies. Our mission is to facilitate the acceleration of novel therapies that will benefit patients with life-threatening and life-altering diseases.

Name: Acucela Inc.
Description: Acucela Inc. is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Kubota Pharmaceutical Holdings Co., Ltd. (Tokyo 4596), committed to translating innovation into a diverse portfolio of drugs and devices to preserve and restore vision for millions of people worldwide. Acucela’s development pipeline include drug candidates and therapeutics for the treatment of retinitis pigmentosa, proliferative diabetic retinopathy, diabetic macular edema, AMD, Stargardt disease, cataract and presbyopia. The company is also developing a monitoring device for neovascular retinal diseases, to be used directly by patients. http://www.acucela.com; http://www.kubotaholdings.co.jp/en/

Name: HemoShear Therapeutics
Description:
HemoShear Therapeutics is a biotechnology company focused on discovering novel biological targets and developing drugs to treat children’s rare metabolic disorders. Our goal is to discover drugs that save the lives of children who are born with metabolic defects and are unable to sustain basic biochemical processes necessary for life. Our proprietary technology allows us to recapitulate diseases using tissue from livers of children born with genetic defects, interrogate the disrupted biochemical processes, explore drug intervention strategies, and select drug candidates that we believe have high probabilities of clinical success. 
 

HemoShear is markedly different from other biotechnology companies because of our proprietary human disease models and our ability to recreate and interpret complex human biology.  We believe that no other company can match our ability to understand human hepatic, tumor, or vascular disease biology and translate those findings into discovery of safe and effective drug treatments.

 
We are passionate about understanding disease biology and driven to discover drug treatments that improve health outcomes and save lives. For more information, see www.hemoshear.com.

Name: M.S. in Biotechnology Program, UW-Madison
Description:
The M.S. in Biotechnology Program is an interdisciplinary two-year degree designed for working professionals. Its integrated curriculum fuses science, business, legal and regulatory policy and how they impact the assessment of new technology discoveries and the development of commercial biotechnology products and services. 

Through project-based assignments and contemporary case studies emphasizing written and oral communication, students gain the applied knowledge and cross-functional skills sought by companies in the biotechnology industry. 

Conveniently scheduled evening/weekend courses allow students to maintain full-time employment and balance their careers and family lives. The exclusive curriculum is taught by teams of world-class scholars from the University of Wisconsin-Madison and leading industry professionals within the biotechnology industry.

Expert instruction, personalized career resources, and student-centered support focus on one goal — helping you achieve the maximum return on your time and effort. Applications are accepted for an annual Fall semester start.

Name: Phenomics Health
Description:
We are a bioinformatics-based precision medicine platform company translating patient-specific and population-based medical big data into novel pharmacological clinical treatment decision support products and services.

We offer a proprietary technology, the PredictMed Platform, designed to help clinicians and health systems optimize precision in the selection of appropriate medications, drug combinations and dosages that improve each patient's health, while also reducing adverse reactions.

Our PrecīsMed platform represents a significant step forward in accurately assessing a patient’s complete medication profile.  Physicians can finally see the full spectrum of medications present in the patient, and identify appropriate dosing levels for therapeutic effectiveness.  PrecīsMed can accurately assess prescribing trends, medication adherence and EHR coverage, as well as define medication concentrations in patients with comorbid disorders.

Name: Boulder Peptide Foundation
Description: The only conference focused solely on the pharmaceutical development of peptide therapeutics

Name: ALT | American Laboratory Trading
Description:
American Laboratory Trading (ALT) provides high-quality refurbished laboratory equipment to thousands of clients in the life sciences, from academia to industry. ALT is the largest supplier of premium used lab equipment in North America with more than 6,000 instruments in stock, ranging from benchtop accessories to robust triple quad mass spectrometers.

ALT is also a trusted provider of laboratory surplus management services, helping companies and research institutions to safely dispose of and recycle their surplus laboratory equipment while maximizing their return on investment.

With sales, service, and warehouse facilities in Connecticut and Northern California, American Laboratory Trading offers equipment and services from coast to coast and around the world, serving customers in more than 60 countries.

Name: J Gold Cannabis
Description: At J Gold Fertilizer, We’ve got a team of top scientists working night and day to make products that will make your grow room produce bigger, tastier, and more plentiful crops. Research back by BioX University.

Name: Phenomix Sciences
Description: Phenomix Sciences is a precision medicine obesity biotechnology pioneer on a mission to conquer obesity globally through the science of phenotyping, the understanding of how genes combined with environmental and behavioral factors can inform obesity treatment plans. Mayo Clinic physicians, scientists, and researchers, Drs. Acosta and Camilleri, founded the company under the belief that the key to understanding obesity is unprecedented access to its clinical and molecular information throughout all stages and phenotypes of the disease.  Phenomix leverages data intelligence to yield better accuracy in predicting individual patient response to specific weight loss interventions and reducing the variability in weight loss results for patients.

Name: Dalan Animal Health, Inc.
Description: Dalan's novel platform technology has introduced the world's first-ever honeybee vaccine, marking a pivotal milestone for the industry. Our mission is to safeguard the planet’s most underserved animal species, ensuring their continued well-being for global food security and the overall health of our planet.

Name: Dovetail Therapeutics
Description: Dovetail Therapeutics is a Seattle biopharmaceutical company founded in 2023 by OrbiMed, the world’s leading healthcare venture capital firm. Dovetail is committed to developing novel biotherapeutics that will meaningfully improve the lives of patients. The company has established a transformative, proprietary platform and a robust, expanding pipeline, with its lead drug candidate entering the clinic this year.

Name: Theralink Technologies, Inc.
Description:
At Theralink Technologies, our approach is based on more than 16 years of research and development. Our research indicates that genomic and transcriptomic information alone provides an incomplete information resource for physicians to make patient-specific treatment decisions.

Our phosphoproteomic RPPA approach is the only commercial platform that quantifies the activation state (phosphorylation) of drug target proteins and their downstream signaling partners within the tumor tissue.

Our advanced technology exploits our understanding of the drug-receptor and drug-protein interactions that drive treatment responses. The Theralink assay has been developed to provide physicians with a treatment decision support tool to assist in selecting therapies that are more likely to result in responses to treatment.

Our large panel of new protein biomarkers targets therapeutic molecular inhibitors including current FDA approved therapies and certain investigational drugs, making Theralink an invaluable tool for oncologists and biopharma clinical trials.

Name: AngioInsight
Description: AngioInsight offers a transformative AI-driven solution for real-time, non-invasive assessment of stenosis and Fractional Flow Reserve (FFR). Our technology delivers rapid, accurate data on flow dynamics and anatomy, aiding in the detection of microvascular disease. With an automated, streamlined workflow, AngioInsight integrates AI diagnostics efficiently, ensuring precision and reliability in cardiovascular care.

Name: Evia Bio
Description:
Evia BioTM is a life science innovation company enabling the growing cell therapy market. We provide new non-DMSO cryopreservation solutions developed by world-leading cryobiologist, Allison Hubel, PhD. We partner with cell therapy companies looking to advance their products to clinical trials and commercialization. Our solutions unlock the full potential of emerging life-saving therapies through the use of all-natural organic compounds to protect the integrity of cells during cryopreservation and patient safety at the point of care.

Please visit www.eviabio.com.

Name: Priothera SAS
Description: We are dedicated to improving the lives of patients suffering from hematological malignancies by delivering an innovative immune modulator to enhance the curative potential of allogeneic Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation (HSCT)

Name: Agscent
Description:
Agscent is the world leader in livestock breath diagnostics. Agscent was founded on a farm in regional NSW, Australia and brings nanotechnology from NASA and world leading Universities to the livestock sector. We are revolutionizing pregnancy testing, disease diagnostics and methane measurement with an easy to use, immediate, affordable, and accurate cutting-edge nanotechnology platform. 

Reproductive management is the most important economic variables in livestock production. Agscent has developed a non-invasive, rapid, cost-effective and easy to use breath diagnostic device for the primary producer sector. This technology will improve breeding productivity for primary producers and provide a safer option for pregnancy testing.

Name: Lynch Regenerative Medicine, LLC
Description: Lynch Regenerative Medicine

Name: BlueWillow Biologics, Inc.
Description: BlueWillow Biologics is developing and enabling a new generation of safe and effective nasal vaccines to protect global populations from respiratory infections, sexually transmitted diseases, and food allergies. Our novel intranasal NanoVax adjuvant platform activates mucosal immunity, the body’s first line of defense, while also inducing systemic immunity. We are a clinical-stage company advancing a pipeline of proprietary programs including Peanut Allergy, HSV-2, Covid-19, Anthrax, Pandemic Flu and RSV.

Name: NorthernBio
Description: At Northern Bio, better lives begin with science. We go beyond the conventional, applying advanced surgical techniques and research methodologies to target the source of the disease, thereby maximizing their impact and potential to transform lives. We are more than just our research. We are a collaborative community of scientists who believe in open communication, transparency, and strong partnerships. We partner with our sponsors, offering tailored solutions and expert guidance at every step. Our commitment to excellence, responsibility, and trust is unwavering, guiding us as we tackle some of the most challenging conditions in human health. With every experiment, every analysis, every discovery, we strive to make a difference. We’re driven by a desire to serve those in need, safeguard human and animal health, and push the boundaries of scientific knowledge. At Northern Bio, possibilities become reality, and better lives begin.

Name: INNOPSYS
Description:
Innopsys is a private company focused on the development and commercialization of fluorescence confocal scanners and software. The company is presently marketing a full range of microarray scanners known as InnoScan series associated with Mapix image analysis software. The InnoScan product range is compatible with all microarrays and combines sensitivity, speed and resolution (down to 0.5 μm/pixel).
Based on a proprietary disrupting laser scanning technology, Innopsys also offers InnoQuant, a groundbreaking approach to capture whole-slide multichannel images with unprecedented field uniformity and scan speed. Finally, the only quantitative fluorescent slide scanner on the market.

Name: Stem Pharm
Description: Stem Pharm is a neurological drug discovery platform company developing the next-generation of neurologic drugs using a human-first approach. Stem Pharm’s proprietary drug discovery platform is based on human 3D neuro-immune organoids that feature microglia and model neuroinflammation, which play a critical role in many neurological diseases. The company applies this platform to discover and validate disease targets and therapeutics for its internal programs in epilepsy, neurodegeneration, and brain cancer as well as for its biopharma partners’ therapeutic programs. Stem Pharm is based in Madison, WI, a hub for innovative stem cell and biosciences research.

Name: BioLabs New Haven
Description:
BioLabs is dedicated to bringing life-changing discoveries to fruition by accelerating the growth and success of life science startups.

BioLabs pioneered the lab co-working concept and has built a global network of 14 co-working laboratory facilities, changing forever the way life science companies are created. Our sites combine fully equipped, permitted, and staffed co-working lab and office facilities, community-building programming, and unparalleled social and networking opportunities. We help your startup progress further and faster on limited investment capital, achieving a shorter path from proof-of-concept to commercialization.

Name: Altesa BioSciences, Inc.
Description:
Altesa is an innovative, clinical-stage pharmaceutical company dedicated to preventing and treating the leading cause of COPD and asthma exacerbations -- namely viral respiratory infections -- starting with rhinovirus, the most common respiratory virus on the planet.

Our goal is to disrupt the COPD treatment paradigm by targeting the upstream cause of acute respiratory exacerbations -- not accept the status quo of managing the long term downstream consequences like chronic inflammation, hospitalizations and even death.

Name: Forbio Brasil
Description: A Forbio desenvolve, produz e comercializa produtos biológicos para uso na agricultura (desde inoculantes, organismos para controle biológico de pragas e aditivos para sementes), meio ambiente, saúde e banco de cepas. Possui unidades de produção no Brasil, Argentina e Colômbia. Seu mercado inclui os seguintes países: Brasil, Argentina, Colômbia, Bolívia, Paraguai e Estados Unidos.

Name: Alphina Therapeutics
Description:
At Alphina Therapeutics we are working to fulfill the promise of precision oncology — higher response rates for more patients. Our approach combines two cutting-edge scientific breakthroughs:

First, our drug candidates use antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) technology to deliver potent NAMPT inhibitor payloads directly to the tumor. By disrupting cancer’s energy supply, these next-generation payloads are designed to kill both dividing and non-dividing tumor cells. Importantly, our therapies can be effective even when other ADCs, including Topo1-based treatments, no longer work.

Second, we have developed a proprietary test that identifies the patients most likely to benefit from NAMPT inhibitors. Our goal is simple: match the right treatment with the right patient to achieve superior outcomes. Unlike most targeted treatments that help relatively few patients, ours could benefit more than 450,000 people each year in the U.S. alone.

Our mission is to apply these breakthroughs to deliver smarter, more effective cancer therapies to the patients who urgently need them.

Name: emka TECHNOLOGIES
Description:
emka TECHNOLOGIES has established a leading position in the pharmacology, safety pharmacology and toxicology research community by offering a wide range of software and hardware solutions backed up by several services.  

Customers are active in several research fields, included but not limited to cardiovascular, pulmonary and neurology, working on isolated organs,  electrophysiology, telemetry, PV loops, behaviour studies...  emka TECHNOLOGIES provides a wide  range of services - installation, validation, maintenance, training, assistance, support - to customers worldwide through a network of offices serving regional and national markets. Partnerships have also been developed with leading research instrument manufacturers.

Name: EPYGEN Biotech
Description:
EPYGEN is an Biotechnology organization, headquartered in Dubiotech Park, Dubai, UAE, with offices, labs and manufacturing facilities in Dubai, India and USA. Following the essence of it's corporate slogan “Building Future Strand by Strand”, Epygen conducts research and manufacturing of wide range of Enzymes Proteins for the Therapeutic as well as Industrial Enzyme space. 

Some of Epygen's focus areas are Cardiovascular, Oncology and Antibodies in Therapeutic Proteins and Biofuels, Clean-Tech, Oil & Gas, Pulp & Paper, Fibre and Detergent in Industrial Enzymes. 

Taking the Protein Lab to the Process Floor, Epygen's scientists are constantly challenging the boundaries of Biotech research.

Name: Talus Bio
Description:
Talus Bio is making the regulome visible and druggable. We are building the first platform to map, model, and ultimately write the regulome, unlocking thousands of previously undruggable targets, including transcription factors that drive cancer, autoimmunity, and neurodegeneration.

Our platform measures the regulome directly in living human cells, generating functional datasets at scale for the first time. These data fuel AI models that learn the logic of genome regulation and predict how to modulate it with precision.

Name: Rion
Description: Rion is a clinical-stage regenerative medicine company focused on developing innovative exosome therapeutics that are clinically impactful, accessible, and practical for any patient, anywhere. Rion has developed Purified Exosome Product (PEP), an innovative biologic platform that optimizes the therapeutic power of exosomes for regenerative medicine.

Name: Genome International
Description:
Genome International is a Bio-IT company that provides innovative software products and services in clinical genomics and Information Technology. With decades of expertise in application development, data science, and genome biology, we serve hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, and academic research laboratories to advance patient healthcare.

Our team of genome biologists and bioinformaticians accelerates discovery in the field of genomic medicine by innovating cutting-edge algorithms and technologies that serve a wide variety of institutions in the healthcare sector.

We strive to continually optimize the analysis of clinical genomics data to improve patient diagnosis and treatment. Our vision is to advance the field of personalized medicine by combining our expertise in clinical genomics and Information Technology.

Name: TwinStrand Biosciences
Description: TwinStrand Biosciences Duplex Sequencing patent estate is the foundational technology enabling the ability to accurately identify ultra-low frequency genomic variants that are undetectable by conventional NGS methods. The company's highly sensitive and specific patented Duplex Sequencing technology delivers clearer insights to researchers in applications ranging from residual cancer detection to genetic toxicology. This data can inform critical decisions in public health, and other fields of science on a faster timescale when actions are most impactful. TwinStrand's scientist-leaders have authored more than thirty peer-reviewed articles using Duplex Sequencing technology and have developed a portfolio of more than 150 patents and patent applications. The company has partnered with pharmaceutical companies, academic centers, clinical research networks, molecular diagnostic companies and federal regulatory agencies to bring high precision genomics to the forefront of their science.

Name: Amlan International
Description:
Amlan International is the animal health business of Oil-Dri Corporation of America, a leader in sorbent mineral technology. Amlan leverages Oil-Dri’s 80-plus years of mineral science expertise to develop proprietary, mineral-based feed additives that support optimal intestinal health while adding value for animal protein producers.

The core of our feed additives is our natural mineral ingredient that contains high-capacity opal-CT lepispheres and undergoes proprietary thermal processing specifically tailored for each product. We also create synergistic blends of our mineral with other feed ingredients that further support normal gut function and digestive processes.

Oil-Dri and the single-source mineral used in Amlan products are based in the USA, and because Amlan and Oil-Dri are vertically integrated, we control the quality, reliability, and safety of the mineral — from mine to feed bag. We do this by following sustainable mining practices and through the use of natural ingredients in our products.

Our mineral-based feed additives meet the demands for cleaner food while reducing the inputs needed to raise production animals, helping to decrease the cost and environmental impact of poultry and livestock production. Leading integrators and producers worldwide trust our products to support animal intestinal health and add value to their operations. You can, too.

Name: ADInstruments
Description:
ADInstruments is committed to providing innovative tools for research and education. Our company helps scientists and educators achieve their goals with our industry-leading PowerLab and LabChart data acquisition systems. 

Since 1988, life science research has been and continues to be a key driver for innovation in our research product line. Today, approximately 40,000 ADInstruments data acquisition systems are used worldwide in research and teaching. Our newest and most innovative product, Lt, takes education a step further with its cloud-based learning platform and over 900 pre-configured courses in physiology, biology, medicine, and nursing.

Description:
For over 70 years, BioZyme has pioneered innovative solutions in animal well-being and nutrition through supplements, health products, and feed additives. As an industry leader in fermentation, BioZyme has made it our mission to improve the quality of your animals’ lives. How? By offering innovative, research-proven solutions to challenges faced by animal producers, owners, and advocates.

Founded in 1951 by a former feed salesman, BioZyme was builtforanimalsbyanimal lovers. At the core of our products is AO-Biotics(R) Amaferm(R), a proprietary prebiotic produced from the fungus Aspergillus oryzae. Over 70 years ago, Amaferm paved the way for prebiotic supplements decades before they became commonplace.  

That core ingredient is how BioZyme products promote digestive health, gut health and overall wellness across various species. Our research-driven, animal nutrition solutions provide support for cattle, swine, poultry, sheep, goats, horses, dogs, cats, and more! 

At BioZyme,we mean what we say. We hold ourselves accountable for researching, developing and delivering products that achieve the results we claim. Amaferm has been research-proven to increase digestibility in over 175 published studies and counting. 

BioZyme also uses the same strain of A. oryzae to develop new pre-biotics and post-biotics to enhance our supplements and animal health products. The BioZyme Family of Brands include AO-Biotics, VitaFerm, Gain Smart, Vita Charge, Sure Champ, Vitalize, DuraFerm and Backyard Boost. 

Headquartered in St. Joseph, Missouri, BioZyme brings quality supplements, feed additives, and animal nutrition solutions to a global market. Customers across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and the Middle East know they can turn to BioZyme for care that comes full circle.

With the potential to disrupt the standard of care, the Cybrexa alphalexTM technology is a novel antigen-independent peptide drug conjugate (PDC) platform that enables targeted delivery of highly potent anticancer treatments and aims to revolutionize the standard of care in oncology. The platform consists of a pHLIP peptide, linker, and small molecule anti-cancer agent.pHLIP peptides are a family of pH-Low Insertion Peptides that target acidic cell surfaces.pHLIP was developed at Yale University and the University of Rhode Island, and is exclusively licensed to pHLIP, Inc.alphalexTM represents the disruptive next generation in tumor targeting.Early clinical trials of the company’s lead candidate, CBX-12, demonstrate robust efficacy signals and tolerability in patients with metastatic cancer.

Description:
Evestia Clinical is a global specialist Contract Research Organization (CRO) dedicated to accelerating the development of life-changing therapies for biotech innovators. With headquarters in Letchworth, UK, and Charlottesville, Virginia, USA, our combined team of over 150 professionals delivers tailored solutions across the full drug development lifecycle—from Phase 1 through Phase 3 and beyond. This merger strengthens our capabilities in oncology, rare diseases, immunology, and inflammation, while adding deep expertise in neurology and late-stage clinical trial services.

Our clients benefit from:
• Global Infrastructure: Seamless access to international trial networks and regulatory expertise.

• Expanded Therapeutic Reach: Specialized services in high-research areas including ALS/MND, oncology, and neurology.

• Integrated Technology Platforms: Enhanced data management, biostatistics, and trial oversight tools.

Name: NashBio
Description:
At NashBio, we make complex healthcare data easy to use. From idea to execution, we leverage real-world clinical, genomic and imaging data to advance the discovery and development of new therapeutics and diagnostics. A for-profit subsidiary of Vanderbilt University Medical Center, NashBio was launched in 2018 with a mission to harness extensive real-world genomics and other multi-modal datasets, along with powerful bioinformatics tools, to build and deliver a wide range of data products and services that support life science R&D. Our company works with clients in pharma, biotech, diagnostics, medical devices and other life sciences domains to support their most critical R&D use cases. We believe smarter data ultimately enables better outcomes for our clients.
Leveraging Vanderbilt University Innovation, NashBio’s hallmarks are deep, high quality, longitudinal datasets that are demographically diverse and clinically relevant, integrated and curated for ease of customer use. Music Beats Cancer offers a model for redefining our social contract for the war on cancer. Central to this, we believe the public can and must play a greater role shaping a more innovative approach to fighting cancer. Our mission is to increase promising treatments in the pipeline by empowering individuals to directly support bio-entrepreneurs translating research into groundbreaking cancer solutions.

Name: Global Regulatory Writing & Consulting (GLOBAL)

At Global Regulatory Writing & Consulting (GLOBAL), we specialize in providing expert drug and device consulting, regulatory submission support, and strategic writing services. With a focus on delivering high-quality, customized solutions, we ensure your project receives the personal attention it deserves. Description: ONL Therapeutics (ONL) is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company committed to developing first-in-class therapeutics to protect and improve the vision of patients with retinal disease. By advancing a breakthrough technology designed to protect key retinal cells from Fas-mediated cell death, ONL is pioneering a new approach to preserving vision. ONL is developing a platform of products for use in a range of blinding diseases, including age-related macular degeneration, retinal detachment, glaucoma, and inherited retinal disease.

Name: Trevi Therapeutics, Inc.
Description:
Trevi Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing the investigational therapy HaduvioTM (oral nalbuphine extended-release) for the treatment of chronic cough in patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF), non-IPF interstitial lung disease (non-IPF ILD), and refractory chronic cough (RCC). Haduvio is the first and only investigational therapy to show a statistically significant reduction in cough frequency in clinical trials with IPF chronic cough patients and RCC patients. Haduvio acts on the cough reflex arc both centrally and peripherally as a kappa agonist and a mu antagonist (KAMA), targeting opioid receptors that play a key role in controlling chronic cough. Nalbuphine is not currently scheduled by the U.S. Drug Enforcement Agency. 

Trevi is headquartered in New Haven, CT.

Name: Biothera Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
Description:
Biothera Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, clinical stage immuno-oncology company developing our proprietary immunotherapy, Imprime PGG, in combination with immune checkpoint inhibitors, or CPIs, for multiple cancer indications.  Imprime PGG is a biologic innate immune modulator that activates the immune system and coordinates anti-cancer immune responses that result in increased activation of cancer-specific T cells.  Preclinical studies demonstrate that Imprime PGG can enhance the efficacy of anti-cancer immune responses in combination with CPI, tumor-targeting and anti-angiogenic antibodies.  

The Company has clinical research agreements with Merck, Genentech and AstraZeneca to evaluate Imprime PGG in combination with CPIs in multiple cancer indications, including metastatic triple negative breast cancer, head and neck cancer and colorectal cancer.  Imprime PGG has shown strong evidence of tolerability in clinical trials with more than 500 subjects, including over 400 cancer patients.  For more information, visit us at www.biothera.com.

Description:
Aptevo Therapeutics is a biotech company primarily focused on bringing novel oncology and hematology therapeutics to market. We leverage the innovative ADAPTIRTM platform technology, a unique approach to cancer immunotherapy, to improve outcomes for cancer patients.

Based in Seattle, Washington, the company is proud of its empowering work environment, entrepreneurial culture, and proprietary platform technology. Name: Delve Health
Description:
Delve Health is a clinical trial execution partner focused on one critical gap: what happens between visits.

While most platforms capture data, Delve ensures that data is actually collected—consistently, reliably, and at scale. Through a unified model that combines eCOA/ePRO, wearable integration, and Concierge-as-a-ServiceTM, we actively manage patient compliance, engagement, and data integrity across the full study lifecycle.

Our Clinical StudyPalTM platform enables sponsors, CROs, and research sites to deploy digital endpoints, remote assessments, and hybrid trial models without adding operational burden. We support a wide range of therapeutic areas including cardiology, oncology, CNS, dermatology, metabolic disease, and rare conditions—where long-term follow-up and adherence are critical to success.

What makes Delve different is execution ownership.

At the core of this is our Concierge-as-a-ServiceTM model—a dedicated human layer assigned to every patient. This is not traditional support. Our protocol-trained, multilingual concierge team actively engages patients, reinforces study requirements, resolves issues in real time, and closes the loop on missed activities. Where technology can remind, humans ensure follow-through.

We don’t rely on passive dashboards. Our platform and concierge team work together to detect early signs of drift—missed diaries, declining device use, disengagement—and intervene before they impact endpoints. This results in consistently high performance across studies, including >92% ePRO completion and >95% device compliance.

Delve consolidates what is typically fragmented across multiple vendors—eCOA, wearables, engagement, and support—into a single, coordinated solution. This reduces complexity, improves visibility, and strengthens dataset integrity.

Whether supporting post-market studies, decentralized trials, or real-world evidence programs, Delve ensures that execution matches protocol intent.

Name: MSU Plant Resilience Institute
Description:
The Plant Resilience Institute, or PRI, at Michigan State University is an internationally recognized Center of Excellence for groundbreaking laboratory and field research on plant resilience, where adaptable future leaders of plant research are trained, and the advancement of plant resiliency in our society and environment is advocated for and prioritized.

Climate instability threatens agricultural productivity. Stabilizing crop production will require the development of crops that are more resistant to abiotic and biotic stresses including drought, high temperature, flooding, disease, and insect pests. By bringing together leading plant researchers and eminent interdisciplinary labs, PRI provides the resources and platform to drive unique solutions to these global challenges.

Name: Computomics
Description:
We are Computomics - a biotech company enabling customers to reap the benefits of our advanced machine learning algorithms. 

By applying AI to genetics, phenotype, microbiome, and environmental datasets, we unlock the diversity of biological life. Computomics is a team of world-leading experts in machine learning, plant research and bioinformatics.

In over 180 projects, we enabled our customers to make data-driven decisions and thereby accelerate sustainable agricultural development that can feed the world. Our advanced machine learning methods enable rapid understanding of genomic data for plant breeding, agricultural, biotech, and microbiome researchers. 

Computomics has its headquarters in Tübingen, Germany.

Name: Axio BioPharma
Description:
Axio BioPharma is building the vendor-neutral data infrastructure for biomanufacturing.

Biomanufacturing runs on a dozen enterprise systems that do not talk to each other. LIMS, MES, ELN, Historian, ERP, QMS, and more. Every tech transfer, every investigation, and every handoff between pharma sponsors and their manufacturing partners breaks on the same problem: critical process data is fragmented across organizational and technical boundaries.

We are not building AI models. We are building the coordination layer that makes AI possible.

Axio Lattice is a federated data platform that connects process data across sponsors and their manufacturing partners without centralizing it. Data stays in pharma's environment. Ownership never changes hands. Meaning is standardized through a neutral layer that works across every major enterprise system biomanufacturing depends on.

Axio Lab is a Madison-based, non-GMP, high-throughput antibody production facility. It delivers fee-for-service campaigns to biotech and pharma teams while generating the clean, structured datasets and commercial relationships that seed Lattice deployments.

We are vendor-neutral by design. Large manufacturers cannot host this network because sponsors will not put their process data on a competitor's platform. Pharma-built internal data teams cannot solve it alone because the problem is cross-organizational by definition. Axio sits between them, owned by neither, trusted by both.

Headquartered in Madison, Wisconsin. Backed by operators and advisors from Catalent, CrowdStrike, Danaher, and the Allen Institute.

If you are a sponsor, manufacturing partner, or technology vendor working on the data fragmentation problem, we would like to hear from you.

Name: Novel Bio
Description: Novel Bio makes radically better plasmid DNA for genetic medicines. Accelerate your pipeline with reliable, high-quality plasmids for even your toughest designs, delivered by real DNA experts. We aim to overcome the DNA bottleneck and help bring a new generation of medicine to patients.

Name: The Probiotics Institute by Chr. Hansen Inc
Description:
The Probiotics Institute by Chr. Hansen Inc. was launched in April 2020. The platform is designed for US audience to break down misconceptions and increase understanding of probiotics, microbiome and our health.

In December 2022, Chr. Hansen and Novozymes entered into an agreement to create a leading global biosolutions partner by combining the two companies. The goal was to unleash the full potential of biological solutions and generate significant value for all stakeholders and society. The combination was completed in January 2024 and Novonesis was born. 

The Probiotics Institute by Chr. Hansen Inc., part of Novonesis Group.

Name: Callio Therapeutics
Description: Callio Therapeutics is pioneering the next generation of antibody-drug conjugates with a pipeline of dual-payload ADCs designed to overcome treatment resistance and drive deeper, more durable responses. While first-generation ADCs have transformed cancer treatment, most patients ultimately progress and have urgent need for better therapies. Powered by highly adaptable dual-payload technology, backed by top life science investors, and led by an experienced team with a track record of success, Callio Therapeutics is built to deliver better outcomes for patients.

Name: bioXcellerator
Description:
BioXcellerator - a global leader in stem cell therapy and research – is dedicated to alleviating pain & suffering, giving new hope to those who suffer from autoimmune and degenerative diseases and improving people’s health, immunity, longevity, and overall quality of life.

Our team of more than 50 passionate and dedicated people including leading scientists, physicians, and researchers work each day to develop scientific breakthroughs to transform the quality of people’s lives through advanced stem cell therapies.

Name: BLOODPAC
Description: Our mandate is to accelerate the development and validation of liquid biopsy assays to improve the outcomes of patients with cancer. To do so we developed the BLOODPAC Data Commons that enables sharing of information between stakeholders in industry, academia, and regulatory agencies.

Name: Cell Therapy Jobs
Description:
A recruiter support service for candidate sourcing highly specialized and penetrated in the regenerative medicine industry including cell therapy, tissue engineering, gene therapy, tissue engineering, bioprinting and stem cell research.
